軽く手を挙げて応じる。

lines.japanese: 「わかってる。うかつなことは言わないよ」

自身がそう積極的な性格ではないためか……使命
感に溢れた人間が、遠い。

lines.japanese: 疎外感に襲われる忍。

lines.japanese:
もちろん仲間の中に、能動的な人間がいなかった
わけではない。

ただ、世界の中心にいるかのような心の密度、若

lines.english: But that density of spirit, as if they stood at the center of the world—that young, arrogant sense of omnipotence—had been foreign to them.

未来に期待せず、今だけを見ている七人の関係は、

lines.english: But the time of peace was over. He had known from the beginning that it would be. The feast was over. Over to the very end.

寂しかった。

lines.english: He was lonely. Because he had known it would end someday. And the ending would not stop at shattering the sanctuary the seven had shared.

気配を読み取るような、長く見えざる手を持って

lines.english: Even with long, invisible hands that sensed presences, he found it difficult to probe inside an enclosed space.

だから扉の向こうに千鳥がいたことは、忍にとって

家にいる時の気分で、ついそう呟きかけて、

lines.japanese:
情緒の揺らぎがない。

lines.japanese: 「失礼します！」
lines.english: “Excuse me!”

lines.japanese:
そんな際だった声を、いったい何年ぶりに発した
だろうか。

lines.japanese:
忍と千鳥の関係が、偽りに塗り込められる以前の、

何も変わってなどいない。

ここではどのような能力者も、力を発揮できない

明らかに、現象行使者との接見のために用意され

　べるでしょうし」
lines.english: “They too will make every effort to determine what you might want.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は別に豪邸を必要とはしていないんですが」
lines.english: “I don't particularly need a mansion.”

lines.japanese:
「……あなたが廃墟にこもって六人のクローズド
　と作り上げた園から、彼らはそう読み取るのです
　よ……」
lines.english: “...That is what they infer from the garden you created in seclusion among the ruins with six Closed...”

lines.japanese: 「……それはまったく違うものです」
lines.english: “...That is something entirely different.”

lines.japanese: 「国民性の違いでしょう、それは」
lines.english: “Perhaps that is a difference in national character.”

lines.japanese:
眉間に皺が寄る。
　得体の知れないもやもやが、胸のあたりにわだか
まっていた。
lines.english: His brow furrowed. An unnameable unease had settled somewhere in his chest.

lines.japanese:
「会見は非公式。場所はこの部屋。時間は直前まで
　通達されません。また時間外に顔を会わせること
　もできません」
lines.english: “The meeting will be unofficial and will take place in this room. You will not be informed of the time until immediately beforehand, nor may you meet him outside the appointed time.”

lines.japanese:
「決められたスケジュールに従って行動し、必要の
　ない外出は控えるようにすること。また武器の携
　行は認められません。注意するように」
lines.english: “Follow the prescribed schedule and refrain from unnecessary excursions. You will not be permitted to carry weapons. Be mindful of that.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
「……おそらく、様々な立場の人間が、それぞれの
　思惑からあなたに種々の提案を持ちかけることで
　しょう」
lines.english: “...People in all manner of positions will likely approach you with proposals of every kind, each driven by motives of their own.”

lines.japanese:
「現在、当研究所は国際的にも微妙な立場に置かれ
　ていますから」
lines.english: “At present, this institute also occupies a delicate position internationally.”

lines.japanese:
「我々は……そのことには干渉できない立場です。
　公には」
lines.english: “We... are in no position to interfere in such matters. Officially.”

lines.japanese: 「……意味がよくわかりません」
lines.english: “...I don't quite understand.”

lines.japanese: 「我々は政府に利用されるのだと理解なさい」
lines.english: “Understand this: the government will use us.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ、政府といっても二国分。同盟とはいえ、と
　うてい一枚岩とはいえない状況です」
lines.english: “And by government, I mean two governments. They may be allies, but they are far from united.”

lines.japanese: 「引き替えこちらには、渉外に長けた人間がいない」
lines.english: “We, meanwhile, have no one skilled in diplomacy.”

lines.japanese:
「抵抗してもいいように利用されるだけのものでしょ
　う。切り札を持っているとはいえ、相手は海千山千
　です」
lines.english: “However we resist, they will use us as they please. We may hold the trump card, but our opponents are seasoned operators.”

lines.japanese:
「……最悪、思惑が交錯し、計画自体が頓挫する可
　能性もあります。それだけは避けねばなりません」
lines.english: “...At worst, their conflicting designs could cause the plan itself to collapse. That, above all, must be avoided.”

lines.japanese: 「では、どうしたら？」
lines.english: “Then what should I do?”

lines.japanese: 「これを」
lines.english: “Take this.”

lines.japanese: 一枚の書類を机の上に置き、忍の側に滑らせた。
lines.english: She placed a sheet of paper on the desk and slid it toward Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「これは？」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese:
日米政府高官の名前と、背後関係の概要。その優
先度。
lines.english: The names of senior Japanese and American officials, an outline of their connections, and their priority rankings.

lines.japanese:
そして予想される要求と、それに対する“模範的
な解答”。
lines.english: Then their expected demands, and the “model answers” to each.

lines.japanese:
「優先順位の高い相手には尻尾を振って首肯なさい。
　そうでない呼びかけには、どうとでも受け取れる
　曖昧な対応を。細かいことはそこにある通りです」
lines.english: “Wag your tail and nod your agreement to anyone of high priority. Give lesser overtures an ambiguous response that can mean anything. The particulars are written there.”

lines.japanese: 「つまらないことをさせますが、先方の希望です」
lines.english: “This is a tedious business to put you through, but the other side requested it.”

lines.japanese:
そのとき忍を襲ったのは、視界が暮れるほどの目
眩だ。
lines.english: At that moment, vertigo swept over Shinobu so violently that his vision darkened.

lines.japanese: かつてなら決して出さない声を発した。
lines.english: He spoke in a voice he would never have used before.

lines.japanese: 「……世界が、終わろうとしているのに？」
lines.english: “...When the world is about to end?”

lines.japanese:
無数の国との不和から、かつての王座にかろうじ
てしがみついてる大国。
lines.english: A great power barely clinging to its former throne amid discord with countless nations.

lines.japanese:
そして今だに、属国意識で今を保守することに必死
な島国。
lines.english: And an island nation still desperate to preserve the present by clinging to a vassal-state mentality.

lines.japanese:
「総動員したって……人は今のままじゃ災厄をくぐ
　り抜けられないのに？」
lines.english: “Even if we mobilized everyone... humanity as it is still couldn't survive the disaster, could it?”

lines.japanese:
書類に整然と並んだ名前と顔写真と等級付けが、
まるで頭に入らない。
lines.english: The names, photographs and rankings neatly arranged on the page simply would not register.

lines.japanese: 記憶できない。
lines.english: He could not memorize them.

lines.japanese:
「こんな些末なことで、集めた力さえ……
　乱されて……」
lines.english: “Over something this petty, even the strength we've gathered... is being thrown into disarray...”

lines.japanese:
怒り、だったのだろうか。
　忍の手が、書類を握り潰しかけた。
　あずさの顔が浮かんだ。
lines.english: Was it anger? Shinobu's hand nearly crushed the document. Azusa's face rose before him.

lines.japanese:
沙也加も。笛子も、葉子も、斎も。
　章二も。
lines.english: Sayaka. Fueko, Youko, Itsuki. Shouji too.

lines.japanese:
ならば、彼らは何のために？
　赤色の怒り。
　ついで紺碧の諦念。
lines.english: Then what were they for? Red anger. Then deep-blue resignation.

lines.japanese: 「これが……」
lines.english: “This is...”

lines.japanese: すべてを捨てて携わる、最後の仕事だという。
lines.english: This was to be his final task, for which he had abandoned everything.

lines.japanese:
「……まるで……茶番です……今さら、誰にゴマを
　すったところで……」
lines.english: “...It's all... a farce... At this point, what good could currying favor with anyone possibly do...?”

lines.japanese: 「おやめなさい」
lines.english: “That will be enough.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたはすでに、選択のできる立場ではありませ
　ん。私たちも」
lines.english: “You are no longer in a position to choose. Neither are we.”

lines.japanese:
押し黙る忍。
　胸中の澱が外に出なかったことは幸か不幸か、
当人にもわからない。
lines.english: Shinobu fell silent. Whether it was a blessing or a curse that the dregs in his heart never spilled out, even he could not say.

lines.japanese:
愚者は手にした黄金を埋める。
　増やしもしないが、減らしもしない。
lines.english: A fool buries the gold he possesses. He neither increases it nor diminishes it.

lines.japanese:
黄金の価値をわざわざ埋没させる者たちを、なん
と呼べば良いのか？
lines.english: What should one call those who go out of their way to bury the value of gold itself?

lines.japanese: 忍にはわからない。
lines.english: Shinobu did not know.

lines.japanese: ただ一つ、断言できることがあるとすれば、
lines.english: If there was one thing he could say for certain—

lines.japanese: 「ひとつ、いいですか」
lines.english: “May I ask one thing?”

lines.japanese: 「なんです？」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese:
「どの国の賛同も得られなかった。いや、自国内部
　にだって隠している」
lines.english: “Not one country agreed to it. No—we're hiding it even within our own borders.”

lines.japanese:
「そもそも全容を知っている人間なんて数えるほど
　しかいない。この大統領様だって、ＧＶＰのなん
　たるかを知ってはいないはずです」
lines.english: “Only a handful of people know the whole story in the first place. Even the illustrious president himself can't possibly know what the GVP really is.”

lines.japanese:
「二国しかない。だというのに、こんなことに手間
　暇を割いているような……そんな世界では、そん
　なやり方では―――」
lines.english: “There are only two countries involved. And still they waste time and effort on this... In a world like this, if this is how we mean to proceed—”
“The world—”

lines.japanese: 茶番の末には、確実な破滅があるだろう―――
lines.english: Certain ruin waited at the end of the farce—

lines.japanese:
過ぎ去りつつある人類史の結末が、ありありとわ
かる。
lines.english: He could see with perfect clarity how human history, already slipping away, would end.

lines.japanese:
振り返れば、紡がれてきた人の歴史は数珠のよう
に繋がっている。
lines.english: Looking back, the history humanity had woven stretched behind him like a string of prayer beads.

lines.japanese:
汚れているが、輝かしい日々だ。
　ただ過去にしか価値がないとさえ思える。
　誰も助けられない。
lines.english: Stained, yet glorious days. It almost seemed as though value belonged to the past alone. No one could be saved.

lines.japanese: （……滅びるんだ……）
lines.english: (...We’re going to perish...)

lines.japanese:
これから直面するであろう失敗を、忍は後悔した。
　不思議な感情だった。
　未来の過失を、なぜ今後悔できるのか。
lines.english: Shinobu regretted a failure he had yet to face. It was a strange feeling. How could he regret a future mistake now?

lines.japanese:
破滅はもう決まったことだからだろうか？
　勝ち目などない。わかりきっている。
　現在の価値は、未来によって意味を持つ。
lines.english: Was it because ruin was already a foregone conclusion? There was no chance of victory; that much was obvious. The present derived its value from the future.

lines.japanese:
圧倒的な終わりしかないのであれば、現時点のど
んな崇高さも無意味だ。
　……聖域でさえも。
lines.english: If nothing lay ahead but an overwhelming end, then nothing in the present, however sublime, could mean a thing. ...Not even the sanctuary.

lines.japanese:
自分が価値を見いだせば、結果終わったとしても
無駄ではない。そう、血気盛んな者は言うだろう。
lines.english: If you find value in something, then even if it ends, it hasn't been wasted. Or so some hot-blooded soul would insist.

lines.japanese:
果たして、そうだろうか？
　一個人の終焉についてならば、該当するかも知れ
ない。
lines.english: But was it really true? It might be true of the end of one individual.

lines.japanese:
だが……全人類が等しく終わるとするならば？
　記憶しなければならない書類を、忍はもう見るこ
とができなかった。
lines.english: But... what if all humanity came to the same end? Shinobu could no longer look at the document he was meant to memorize.

lines.japanese: 「ここで記憶してください」
lines.english: “Commit it to memory here.”

lines.japanese: 「……もう憶えました……」
lines.english: “...I've already memorized it...”

lines.japanese: 閉じた瞳のまま、突き返す。
lines.english: Still with his eyes closed, he pushed it back.

lines.japanese:
紙を拉ぐ音がした。
　見ると、千鳥は自ら書類をねじっていた。
lines.english: Paper crumpled. When he looked, Chidori herself was twisting the document in her hands.

lines.japanese: 「千鳥、さん……？」
lines.english: “Chidori...?”

lines.japanese:
微量の安堵めいた表情は、すぐに抹消される。
　千鳥はライターを取り出し、灰皿の上で火をつけた。
lines.english: The faintest trace of relief appeared on her face, then was erased at once. Chidori took out a lighter and set the document on fire over the ashtray.

lines.japanese:
書類は燃える。
　忍への賛同から書類を破棄したわけではなかった。
lines.english: The document burned. She had not destroyed it because she agreed with Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
二人の視線が、隠滅された記録を糧に燃えさかる、
小さな炎に吸い寄せられた。
lines.english: Their gazes were drawn to the little flame that fed on the record being erased.

lines.japanese: 無価値な紙切れが、灰へと変わるまで。
lines.english: Until the worthless scrap of paper turned to ash.

lines.japanese: 「以上です」
lines.english: “That is all.”

lines.japanese:
そして千鳥は退室した。反対側のドアから。
　忍はずっと、灰皿の上を凝視していた。
lines.english: Then Chidori left. Through the door on the other side. Shinobu never took his eyes off the ashtray.
“...Atemiya?”

lines.japanese: いつの間にか、南が入室していた。
lines.english: Minami had entered without him noticing.

lines.japanese: 「助かるものか……」
lines.english: “As if anyone's going to be saved...”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「誰一人、助かるものか……」
lines.english: “No one. Not one of us is going to be saved...”

lines.japanese: まるで、怨嗟のような声。
lines.english: His voice was almost a curse.

lines.japanese: 「おまえがそんな調子では、そうだろうな」
lines.english: “Not while you're in that state.”

lines.japanese:
逆撫でされた。
　忍は南の胸ぐらをつかむ。
lines.english: The words struck a raw nerve. Shinobu grabbed Minami by the collar.

lines.japanese: 壁に押しつけた。
lines.english: He shoved him against the wall.

lines.japanese:
「精神論に持って行くな。一丸になれないなら、力
　の集めようがないと言っている」
lines.english: “Don't make this about willpower. I'm saying we can't concentrate our strength unless we act as one.”

lines.japanese: 「っ……ＧＶＰの基礎概念だな、それは」
lines.english: “Ngh... That's the basic principle of the GVP.”

lines.japanese:
「力を結集するために王を立て中央集権国家を擁立
　する」
lines.english: “Install a king and establish a centralized state to concentrate power.”

lines.japanese:
「そうだ。僕は傀儡の王というわけだ。だがこれで
　は力を発揮することもできるかどうか」
lines.english: “Right. So I get to be the puppet king. But at this rate, I don't even know whether I'll be able to wield that power.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえは、まさにその強制権を忌み嫌っていたん
　じゃないのか？」
lines.english: “I thought that power to compel was exactly what you hated.”

lines.japanese:
「人の心を踏みにじる王の権力を忌避していた。違
　うか？」
lines.english: “You abhorred a king's power to trample the human heart. Am I wrong?”

lines.japanese: 長い時間をかけて、忍は認めた。
lines.english: Only after a long silence did Shinobu concede the point.

lines.japanese: 「違わないさ」
lines.english: “No. You're right.”

lines.japanese:
「ならば、どんな現実が突きつけられようと、憤る
　ことはないはずだ」
lines.english: “Then whatever reality is thrust upon you, you should have no cause for anger.”

lines.japanese: 南は壁際の磔から解放される。
lines.english: The crucified Minami was released from the wall.

lines.japanese:
「何を言われたか、俺は詳しくは聞かされていない
　が……おまえはもう少し、一貫した方針を持った
　方がいい」
lines.english: “I wasn't told exactly what she said to you... but you'd do well to choose a course and stick to it.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は、矛盾してるかな……」
lines.english: “Am I... contradicting myself?”

lines.japanese: その声に、南は当惑したようだった。
lines.english: Something in his voice seemed to disconcert Minami.

lines.japanese: 「望んで得た自分だ……今は、それでいい」
lines.english: “This is the person you wanted to become... For now, let that be enough.”

lines.japanese:
「そのうち、いやでも放棄する羽目になるんだから
　な」
lines.english: “Sooner or later, you'll have no choice but to give it up whether you like it or not.”

lines.japanese: 「そう」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 重く息を吐き出す。
lines.english: He let out a heavy breath.

lines.japanese:
「それより貴宮、今後は俺がおまえの警護を担当
　する」
lines.english: “Never mind that, Atemiya. From now on, I'm assigned to guard you.”

lines.japanese: 「警護？」
lines.english: “Guard me?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだ。あらゆる物理的な襲撃からおまえを護衛
　する」
lines.english: “Yes. I'll protect you from any physical attack.”

lines.japanese: 「……俺の本意ではないが、そういう決定だ」
lines.english: “...It's not my choice, but the decision's been made.”

lines.japanese: 「大事な御神輿だな」
lines.english: “Wouldn't want anything to happen to your precious figurehead.”

lines.japanese:
「道理をわきまえないターゲットを護衛するほど、
　難しいことはない。ご理解いただけるか？」
lines.english: “There's nothing harder than guarding a target who won't see reason. Do you understand me?”

lines.japanese: 「……わかってるよ」
lines.english: “...I get it.”

lines.japanese:
南はすでに任務経験がある。
　第一期に属する南は、年齢的に実戦を体験できる
ギリギリの世代だ。
lines.english: Minami had already been on missions. As a member of the first cohort, he was just old enough to have experienced actual combat.

lines.japanese:
南や忍より年下のスタッフも大勢いるが、任務を
遂行するための知力・体力・能力的な成熟に至って
いる個体は多くない。
lines.english: There were many staff younger than Minami and Shinobu, but few of them were mature enough in intellect, physique and ability to carry out a mission.

lines.japanese:
そして忍たち以前は、屍の山でしかない。
　よって、これは少年少女たちの戦いを意味する。
lines.english: Before Shinobu's generation lay only a mountain of corpses. Which meant this would be a battle fought by boys and girls.

lines.japanese: 忍が黄昏と呼ぶ戦い。
lines.english: The battle Shinobu called twilight.

lines.japanese: 「……楽はできないんだろうな」
lines.english: “...I suppose I won't have it easy.”

lines.japanese: 「その通りだ。それなりの訓練も受けてもらう」
lines.english: “That's right. You'll have some training to do as well.”

lines.japanese: 「いやだな」
lines.english: “I don't like the sound of that.”

lines.japanese: 「高貴なる者の責務だ」
lines.english: “The duty of the highborn.”

lines.japanese:
南の声が、殊更に冷たい。
　報いを強いるようでもあった。
lines.english: Minami's voice turned pointedly cold. It was as though he meant to exact repayment.

lines.japanese:
ベッドに寝ころんで、天井を見上げている。
　考えることはいろいろあるはずなのに、意見はま
とまろうとしない。
lines.english: He lay on the bed, staring at the ceiling. There were any number of things he ought to be considering, yet his thoughts refused to come together.

lines.japanese:
低迷する思考を漂うに任せ、忍はまどろむ。
　不意に眩暈感に見舞われ、目を閉じた。
lines.english: Shinobu let his listless thoughts drift and began to doze. A sudden wave of vertigo washed over him. He closed his eyes.

lines.japanese:
静かだった。
　世界に自分一人しかいないように感じられた。
　もし、そうであったなら……。
lines.english: It was quiet. He felt as though he were the only person in the world. If that were so...

lines.japanese:
屋外のような場所では、世界を感じられる。
　だが遮断された場所にいると、息が詰まった。
lines.english: In places open to the air, he could feel the world. But shut away in an isolated place, he felt stifled.

lines.japanese:
ここには窓もない。
　扉も閉まったままだ。
　家であれば、開け放しておけるのに。
lines.english: There were no windows here. The door remained closed. At home, he could have left it wide open.

lines.japanese:
忍は衣服の胸元をゆるめた。
　どう変わるわけでもないのだが。
　忍は自分の手を見た。
lines.english: Shinobu loosened his collar. Not that it made any difference. He looked at his hand.

lines.japanese:
個体であるということ。
　自分だけが、此処に在るという意義。
　忍の感じているものは、孤独である。
lines.english: The fact of being an individual. The meaning of being here, all by himself. What Shinobu felt was loneliness.

lines.japanese:
密閉空間に押し込められるたびに感受性は剥奪さ
れる。
lines.english: Whenever he was confined in a sealed space, his capacity to feel was stripped from him.

lines.japanese:
世界が感じられなくなる。
　だから……孤独を意識させられる。
　誰もが、こんな孤独の中で生きているのだ。
lines.english: He could no longer feel the world. And so... he was forced to recognize his loneliness. Everyone lived within loneliness like this.

lines.japanese:
だけど忍には、そんな普通の孤独が怖くてたまら
ない。
lines.english: But Shinobu could hardly bear the terror of such ordinary loneliness.

lines.japanese:
誰とも繋がっていないという事実を、再確認させ
られる。
lines.english: It forced him to confront again the fact that he was connected to no one.

lines.japanese:
おそらく忍は、白い部屋での尋問に耐えることは
できない。
lines.english: Shinobu could probably never endure an interrogation in a white room.

lines.japanese:
王であるが故に、一人であるということは義務と
なる。
lines.english: Because he was king, solitude became his duty.

lines.japanese: 最初に絶望に接することも、含めて。
lines.english: That included being the first to encounter despair.

lines.japanese: 「まったく……どうしろって言うんだ」
lines.english: “Honestly... what am I supposed to do?”

lines.japanese:
せめて静かに滅ぶ選択もある。
　少なくとも、苦しまずに済む。
lines.english: At least there was the option of perishing quietly. Then, if nothing else, they would be spared the suffering.

lines.japanese:
伝染病予防プログラムを少し変更すれば、それで
いい。
lines.english: All he had to do was make a small change to the epidemic-prevention program.

lines.japanese:
ゆるやかな死による、やさしい抱擁。
　忍が人類に提案できる、唯一の、幸せな結末。
lines.english: A gentle embrace, in the form of a gradual death. The one happy ending Shinobu could offer humanity.

lines.japanese:
仮に薬殺が困難だったとしても、いざとなれ
ば―――
lines.english: Even if killing them with drugs proved difficult, if it came to that—

lines.japanese: 忍は手を見る。
lines.english: Shinobu looked at his hand.

lines.japanese: 王の力で。
lines.english: With the power of the king.

lines.japanese:
問題は、実行できるかどうか。
　忍には自信がない。
lines.english: The only question was whether he could go through with it. Shinobu wasn't sure.

lines.japanese:
いつも『なんとかなれば』と考え、覆し、懊悩し、
迷路へと舞い戻る。その繰り返し。
lines.english: He kept thinking, If only there were a way, then reversing himself, agonizing, and wandering back into the maze. Over and over.

lines.japanese:
理由づけを探す。
　たとえば……『王の力』は完全ではないこと。
　遂行することは難しいだろう。
lines.english: He searched for a justification. For example... “the power of the king” was incomplete. The task would be difficult to carry out.

lines.japanese:
プログラムの変更にしても、誰が曖昧な破滅に対
してのっけから自殺を選択するのだろう。
lines.english: Even if he changed the program, who would choose suicide from the outset when the coming ruin remained uncertain?

lines.japanese: だが忍は知っている。
lines.english: But Shinobu knew.

lines.japanese:
後悔した時には、もうすべてが遅いのだと。
　蝗の群れは、一瞬で地域を食い荒らす。
　消費し尽くす。
lines.english: By the time they regretted it, it would already be too late. A swarm of locusts could strip a region bare in an instant. Consume every last thing.

lines.japanese: 蝗の群れならまだましかも知れないのだ。
lines.english: A swarm of locusts might still be preferable.

lines.japanese:
忍は絶大な力を秘めた王。
　だが、人のすべてを庇護し敵を退ける力はない。
lines.english: Shinobu was a king who held immeasurable power within him. But he did not have the power to protect every human being and repel the enemy.

lines.japanese: 現実だけが、いつも重い。
lines.english: Only reality was ever heavy.

lines.japanese: 再び、まぶたをおろす。
lines.english: He closed his eyes again.

lines.japanese:
闇。
　今度は精神もゆっくりと沈降していった。
lines.english: Darkness. This time his mind, too, sank slowly.

lines.japanese:
あとはただ、深く深く眠るだけだ。
　冷たい夜がふけていく。
lines.english: All that remained was to sleep, deeper and deeper. The cold night wore on.

lines.japanese: そこは相変わらず、殺風景な場所だった。
lines.english: The place was as stark as ever.

lines.japanese:
一切の装飾が見られない、灰色の部屋。
　掃除だけは行き届いている。血も汗も、痕跡は見
られない。
lines.english: A gray room with no decoration of any kind. Spotlessly clean, at least. Not a trace of blood or sweat remained.

lines.japanese: 「どうした？」
lines.english: “What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……思い出してた」
lines.english: “No... just remembering.”

lines.japanese: 「昔は、ここにいたんだったな」
lines.english: “You used to be here, didn't you?”

lines.japanese:
室内を見渡す。
　十数名のスタッフが集められている。
lines.english: He looked around. A dozen or so staff had gathered.

lines.japanese:
それぞれ、壁や床に身を添えて、関節や筋肉をほ
ぐしていた。
lines.english: Some leaned against the walls, others settled on the floor, loosening their joints and muscles.

lines.japanese: 南も中央の床で、丹念に柔軟を続けている。
lines.english: At the center of the floor, Minami continued stretching with meticulous care.

lines.japanese: 「念入りだね」
lines.english: “You're thorough.”

lines.japanese: 「俺たちは、本来は商品だからな」
lines.english: “We're merchandise, after all.”

lines.japanese:
「ここにいるのはＵＳＥＲのうち、現象行使者とし
　ての特質が強い者ばかりだ」
lines.english: “Everyone here is a USER with a particularly strong aptitude as a wielder of phenomena.”

lines.japanese: 「それって、違うものなのかな」
lines.english: “Are those really different things?”

lines.japanese: 「呆れるな。知らないのか」
lines.english: “Unbelievable. You don't know?”

lines.japanese:
「昔は同義語だったのかも知れないが、今は現象力
　を行使できないＵＳＥＲも多い」
lines.english: “Maybe they used to be synonymous, but now plenty of USERs can't wield phenomenal power.”

lines.japanese:
「魔法は使えないが、端末としては成立する。この
　力のない者も含めて、我々全てはＵＳＥＲと呼ば
　れる」
lines.english: “They can't use magic, but they still qualify as terminals. All of us—including those without that power—are known as USERs.”

lines.japanese:
「そして中でも、効果が確認できるほどの領域に
　到達している者を、現象行使者と呼ぶ」
lines.english: “Among USERs, anyone who has reached the point of producing an observable effect is called a wielder of phenomena.”

lines.japanese:
「そうか……新入りをいちいち調整してられないも
　のね」
lines.english: “I see... It's not like you have time to calibrate every new arrival.”

lines.japanese:
「クローズド・チルドレンの調査だって満足にでき
　ていない」
lines.english: “We haven't even been able to investigate the Closed Children properly.”

lines.japanese: 「……仕方ないとはいえ……」
lines.english: “...Can't be helped, I suppose...”

lines.japanese: 下方から、南が睨み付けてきた。
lines.english: Minami glared up at him from below.

lines.japanese:
「……おまえがしていたことも、クローズドの調査
　だぞ。書類ではそうなってる」
lines.english: “What you were doing was an investigation of the Closed, too. That's how the paperwork classifies it.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだった」
lines.english: “Oh, right.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえほど時間をかけた者もいないがな。あの
　連中については、おかげでデータがほとんど存在
　しない」
lines.english: “No one took as long as you, either. Thanks to that, we have almost no data on that group.”

lines.japanese: 「どうなんだ？　有望なのか？」
lines.english: “Well? Are they promising?”

lines.japanese:
「……一人には細胞を移植したんだ。それで同期が
　起こった」
lines.english: “I transplanted cells into one of them. That caused synchronization.”

lines.japanese: 「同期？」
lines.english: “Synchronization?”

lines.japanese:
「精神形成に影響して、ある種の自己愛的なものに
　発展した。いわゆる洗脳効果が出たんだ」
lines.english: “It influenced the development of the psyche and grew into a kind of narcissism. In other words, it had a brainwashing effect.”

lines.japanese: 「物理的な洗脳か……」
lines.english: “Brainwashing by physical means...”

lines.japanese:
「興味深いサンプルだったので、経年調査の必要が
　あった。他も似たようなものだよ」
lines.english: “It was an interesting sample, so it required a longitudinal study. The others were more or less the same.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほどな……それでか……」
lines.english: “I see... So that's why...”

lines.japanese: 「そっちは？」
lines.english: “What about you?”

lines.japanese:
「主に要人警護・対テロというところだ。ＳＰのよ
　うなものだな」
lines.english: “Mostly VIP protection and counterterrorism. Think of us as something like a protective detail.”

lines.japanese:
南は逆立ちをした。
　そのまま背中側に脚を曲げて地面につけ、上体を
跳ね上げるように起こす。
lines.english: Minami kicked up into a handstand. He arched his legs down behind his back until his feet touched the floor, then sprang his torso upright.

lines.japanese:
ヨガの行者を思わせる柔軟性だった。
　ほぐした全身から、熱気めいた圧迫感が放射される。
lines.english: He had the flexibility of a yogi. His limbered body radiated a pressure that felt like heat.

lines.japanese:
「……おまえは、そういった訓練から遠ざかって久
　しい」
lines.english: “...You've been away from this kind of training for a long time.”

lines.japanese:
「最低限、体の動かし方くらいは身につけておいて
　もらおう」
lines.english: “At the very least, you're going to learn how to handle your own body.”

lines.japanese:
薄く、笑う。
　身の危険さえ感じる。
lines.english: A thin smile. Shinobu felt he might be in danger.

lines.japanese:
室内の全員の意識が、自分に向けられていること
にも気づく。
lines.english: He also realized that everyone in the room had their attention fixed on him.

lines.japanese:
雑多にそれぞれの準備運動をしていたと思いきや、
全員が忍の動向を伺っていたらしい。
lines.english: They had appeared to be going through assorted warm-ups, but every one of them had apparently been watching Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 悪意を感じる。
lines.english: He felt malice.

lines.japanese:
外界から連れ戻された忍に対する、敵愾心がその
根底にある。
lines.english: At its root was hostility toward Shinobu, who had been brought back from the outside world.

lines.japanese:
それまで自由によろしくやっていて、突然戻って
最重要人物……となれば、このやっかみも当然だ。
lines.english: He had been off doing as he pleased, then returned without warning as their most important person... Their resentment was only natural.

lines.japanese: 南も、止める気はないようだ。
lines.english: Minami appeared to have no intention of stopping them.

lines.japanese:
心身が、けだるさに満たされる。
　無意味な行為は、どこにでも転がっているのだ。
lines.english: A leaden weariness filled him, body and mind. Pointless acts lay strewn everywhere.

lines.japanese:
「さて、徒手格闘術の訓練をはじめる。今日は自主練
　ということになっているが……」
lines.english: “All right. We'll begin hand-to-hand combat training. Today is supposed to be independent practice, but...”

lines.japanese: 一同に対して、南は発する。
lines.english: Minami addressed the room.

lines.japanese: 「知っての通り、我々に新しい仲間が加わってくれた」
lines.english: “As you all know, we've been joined by a new comrade.”

lines.japanese: どっ、と室内が沸く。
lines.english: The room erupted.

lines.japanese:
忍だけが笑えない。
　この状況で愛想笑いを浮かべるような人間には、
何事も成せないだろう。
lines.english: Shinobu alone could not laugh. Anyone who could manage a polite smile in a situation like this would never accomplish anything.

lines.japanese: 「聞いてる。新しいリーダーなんだろ？」
lines.english: “We heard. He's our new leader, right?”

lines.japanese:
声が飛ぶ。
　タール状の悪意にまみれた言葉だ。
lines.english: A voice rang out. The words dripped with malice thick as tar.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 肯定とともに、一斉にブーイングがあがる。
lines.english: The confirmation was met with a chorus of boos.

lines.japanese: 「今はまだ、俺の管轄下だがな」
lines.english: “For the moment, he's still under my command.”

lines.japanese:
「だからこいつの訓練プログラムを、考えてやらね
　ばならない」
lines.english: “Which means we need to put together a training program for him.”

lines.japanese:
シン、と静まる。
　場の空気が、ある一つの方向に流れていく。
lines.english: The room fell dead silent. The mood began to flow in a single direction.

lines.japanese:
閉鎖空間をうねる濃密な空気が、静止したように
感じられた。
lines.english: The dense air churning through the enclosed room seemed to come to a halt.

lines.japanese: 途端、むっとした熱気が肌にまとわりつく。
lines.english: At once, stifling heat clung to his skin.

lines.japanese: 「俺が相手をしよう」
lines.english: “I'll take him on.”

lines.japanese:
剣呑な雰囲気の男が、集団から進み出る。
　長身の少年。
lines.english: A dangerous-looking figure stepped out of the group. A tall boy.

lines.japanese:
細く見える四肢はしかし、野生の強靱さを思わせ、
引き絞られた筋肉に包まれている。
lines.english: His limbs looked slender, but they were corded with taut muscle and suggested an animal's wild strength.

lines.japanese: 気配が濃い。が、完璧に消すこともできる。
lines.english: His presence was intense. Yet he could erase it completely.

lines.japanese:
南と相対した時と、同種の危険信号がある。
　見渡せば、その二人より強力な者は存在していな
いように見受けられた。
lines.english: He gave Shinobu the same sense of danger as Minami. A look around suggested that no one here was more powerful than those two.

lines.japanese: 南は腕を組んで静観している。
lines.english: Minami folded his arms and watched.

lines.japanese: 「もともと、そういうことだったんだろ？」
lines.english: “This was always the plan, wasn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「……壊すなよ」
lines.english: “...Don't break him.”

lines.japanese: 「知らないぜ」
lines.english: “No promises.”

lines.japanese:
軽く応じて、相田と呼ばれた少年が進み出た。
　開始の合図もなく。
　拳が来た。
lines.english: With that breezy reply, the boy called Aida stepped forward. There was no signal to begin. A fist came at him.

lines.japanese:
まず、迅速といってよい。
　技自体は単に効率的な軌道でしかない打撃だが……
常人の反応速度で回避するのは至難の業だ。
lines.english: First of all, he was fast. It was only a punch, thrown along an efficient path... but evading it with ordinary human reflexes would be nearly impossible.

lines.japanese:
忍には、やや荷が重い。
　非効率的な動作で、かろうじて回避する。
　拳の先端が鼻先をかすめた。
lines.english: The attack was almost too much for Shinobu. An awkward motion carried him just clear. The knuckles grazed the tip of his nose.

lines.japanese: 距離を取ろうとすると、今度はタックルだ。
lines.english: When he tried to put distance between them, Aida came in with a tackle.

lines.japanese:
拳闘から瞬時に肉弾戦へと移行してきた。
　それは忍の視界には、地面すれすれを滑空してい
るように見えるほど、低い。
lines.english: In an instant, he switched from boxing to a driving tackle. He came in so low that, to Shinobu's eyes, he seemed to be gliding just above the ground.

lines.japanese: 「チッ！」
lines.english: “Tch!”

lines.japanese:
慣れた動きだった。忍はさらに下がる。
　当然だ。相手はプロなのだ。
　異能兵士としての訓練を受けている。
lines.english: His movements were practiced. Shinobu gave more ground. Of course. His opponent was a professional, trained as a paranormal soldier.

lines.japanese: だが今、痩躯の少年は、一切の能力を用いていない。
lines.english: Yet the lean young man was using no abilities whatsoever.

lines.japanese: 格闘技だけで試すつもりなのか？
lines.english: Did he intend to test Shinobu with martial arts alone?

lines.japanese:
何一つ、保証はない。
　訓練であることも忘れ、忍の機能は緊張状態に入る。
lines.english: There were no guarantees. Shinobu forgot this was training. His systems went on alert.

lines.japanese:
これは試練だ。
　新参者をはかる儀式のようなもの。
　間合いを詰めれば拳が来る。
lines.english: This was an ordeal. A rite for taking the measure of a newcomer. Close the distance, and a fist would come.

lines.japanese:
そうかといって引き剥がせば、獣のハンティング
にも似たタックルを許す。
lines.english: Pull away, however, and he left himself open to a tackle like the pounce of a hunting beast.

lines.japanese: さば

一撃で意識を昏倒させられるのは顎だ。
　両腕を前に構え、銃弾にも似た拳闘の技を捌く。
lines.english: A blow to the jaw could knock him unconscious in one hit. Arms raised before him, he parried boxing blows that came like bullets.

lines.japanese:
戦いながら、忍は次第に様々なことを思い出して
いく。
lines.english: As he fought, one thing after another came back to Shinobu.

lines.japanese:
混乱から脱却していく。
　現象行使者としては目の前の少年が上回るかも知
れない。
lines.english: The confusion fell away. As a wielder of phenomena, the boy before him might be superior.

lines.japanese:
忍は効率的な器物破壊などできない。
　風を揺さぶる程度の大味なもので、そうそう実戦
では使えない。
lines.english: Shinobu could not destroy physical objects efficiently. His own power was a blunt instrument, good for little more than stirring the wind, and rarely useful in actual combat.

lines.japanese: しかしＵＳＥＲとしての能力なら。
lines.english: But when it came to his capabilities as a USER—

lines.japanese:
神経が起動し、末端からノルアドレナリンが放出
され、作動性受容体と結合する。
lines.english: His nervous system activated. Noradrenaline was released from the nerve endings and bound to adrenergic receptors.

lines.japanese: 心拍数が増大し、心臓近辺の血管を拡張させる。
lines.english: His heart rate rose, and the blood vessels around his heart dilated.

lines.japanese:
余分な心筋興奮は無駄となるため、心拍出量は最
適値で抑えられる。自動で。
lines.english: Excess myocardial excitation would be wasted, so cardiac output was held at the optimum level. Automatically.

lines.japanese: 気管支平滑筋が弛緩し、最大呼吸量が増す。
lines.english: Bronchial smooth muscle relaxed, increasing maximum respiratory capacity.

lines.japanese:
酸素消費量もかさむが、肉体を用いた高負担行動
には必要な措置として認可する。
lines.english: Oxygen consumption rose too, but the increase was authorized as a necessary measure for strenuous physical activity.

lines.japanese:
興奮状態のコントロール。
　これもまた、ＵＳＥＲの有する力の一端ではある。
　超人化したわけではない。
lines.english: Control of the state of arousal. Another small part of a USER's power. He had not become superhuman.

lines.japanese:
最適緊張状態への切り替えがいくぶん早いという
……それだけのことだ。
lines.english: It only meant he could shift into an optimal state of arousal somewhat faster... nothing more.

lines.japanese: そして神経伝達速度の向上。
lines.english: And faster neural transmission.

lines.japanese: その瞬間、
lines.english: In that instant—

lines.japanese:
世界の動きが、急激にスローなものとなった。
　眼前に立つ少年の傾いだ体は、重力を無視して宙
にかけられているように思える。
lines.english: The world's motion slowed abruptly. The boy's leaning body appeared suspended before him in midair, as if gravity no longer applied.

lines.japanese:
色褪せた風景に、南は組んだ腕をとく途中のポーズ
で固まっていた。
lines.english: Against the faded landscape, Minami stood frozen in the act of unfolding his arms.

lines.japanese: 同時に、忍の四肢も鉄のような重みに支配される。
lines.english: At the same time, a weight like iron shackled Shinobu's limbs.

lines.japanese:
普段通りの速度で動かない。
　いや、動いてはいるのだ。
lines.english: They would not move at their usual speed. No—they were moving.

lines.japanese:
ただ認知速度があまりにも加速されたため、全て
がゆるやかに感じられるに過ぎない。
lines.english: His perception had simply accelerated so far that everything only seemed to move slowly.

lines.japanese: ゆるく迫る拳を捌く手順は、まるで模範解答である。
lines.english: His sequence of moves to parry the slowly approaching fist was like a model answer.

lines.japanese:
闘争のさなか、次々と繰り出される攻め手も、こ
の超低速の世界では他愛ないものとなってしまう。
lines.english: In the midst of the fight, every attack his opponent sent his way became trivial in this world of extreme slow motion.

lines.japanese:
あれほど鋭いと思われた攻撃も、こうして見ると
ずいぶんと荒削りな箇所がある。
lines.english: Even attacks that had seemed so sharp revealed a great many rough edges when seen this way.

lines.japanese: 体重移動の不均衡を、忍は７手先に見通した。
lines.english: Shinobu foresaw an imbalance in the weight shift seven moves ahead.

lines.japanese:
７手先に訪れる均衡の乱れにどうつけ込むかを、
忍は１７通りも考慮することができた。
lines.english: He could consider seventeen different ways to exploit the loss of balance that would come seven moves later.

lines.japanese: そこで忍は気付く。
lines.english: That was when Shinobu realized something.

lines.japanese:
この闘争の目的は、本当に力試しだろうか？
　実戦であれば、おそらくこんな悠長なことはしない。
lines.english: Was this fight really a test of strength? In a real battle, surely no one would take their time like this.

lines.japanese:
現象力なり武器なりを用いて、迅速に無力化する
はずである。
lines.english: They would use phenomenal power or weapons to disable their opponent without delay.

lines.japanese: 拳闘という武器自体、選択されないはずだ。
lines.english: They would never choose boxing itself as the weapon.

lines.japanese:
向かい合っての対決。
　それは周囲に強さを誇示するための手段なのだろう。
lines.english: A face-to-face contest. Most likely, a means of displaying one's strength to the onlookers.

lines.japanese:
そして侮辱するための手段でもある。
　勝つことはできる。
　だが―――
lines.english: And a means of humiliating the opponent. He could win. But—

lines.japanese: 忍は相田のタックルを、あえて受けた。
lines.english: Shinobu deliberately took Aida's tackle.
“...What?”

lines.japanese:
馬乗りになってくる。
　忍は身をよじって逃げようとしたが、かなわない。
　相手の体重が、腰を押さえつけた。
lines.english: Aida straddled him. Shinobu twisted, trying to escape, but could not. The other's weight pinned his hips.

lines.japanese: 「……まあ、やるがな。しかし―――」
lines.english: “…Not bad. But—”

lines.japanese:
そして、
　衝撃―――
lines.english: And then—impact.

lines.japanese:
忍は負けた。
　何発殴られたのか、判然としない。
lines.english: Shinobu had lost. He could not tell how many times he had been hit.

lines.japanese:
天井と、視界周囲にずらりと並ぶ観客の顔が、レ
ンズごしを思わせて歪む。
lines.english: The ceiling and the spectators' faces arrayed around the edges of his vision were distorted as if seen through a lens.

lines.japanese: 室内のＵＳＥＲたちの、嘲笑まじりの蔑み。
lines.english: The USERs’ contempt, mingled with derisive laughter.

lines.japanese:
相田はすでに立ち上がり、衣服を整えている。
　ノーダメージ。
　こちらを振り向いて告げた。
lines.english: Aida was already on his feet, straightening his clothes. Not a scratch on him. He turned back and spoke.

lines.japanese: 「……頼もしいリーダー様だな」
lines.english: “...Some dependable leader.”

lines.japanese: すれ違いざま、南に告げる。
lines.english: He said it to Minami as he passed.

lines.japanese: 「おまえと一緒だ」
lines.english: “Just like you.”
“...Yeah.”

lines.japanese:
一人で部屋を出て行く。
　南は忍に告げる。
lines.english: Aida left the room alone. Minami spoke to Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「……立てるか」
lines.english: “...Can you stand?”

lines.japanese: 「なんとか」
lines.english: “Just about.”

lines.japanese:
上半身を起こす。
　全身の筋肉に、鈍い苦痛がしこりとなって埋め込
まれていた。
lines.english: He pushed himself upright. Dull knots of pain were embedded in every muscle.

lines.japanese:
苦痛を中和することは容易いが、別段処置するほ
どのことでもない。
lines.english: The pain would be easy to neutralize, but he saw no particular need to do anything about it.

lines.japanese: 「こんなに殴られたの、久しぶりだ」
lines.english: “It's been a long time since anyone hit me this much.”

lines.japanese:
顔に触れる。
　髪型もボロボロ。
　口と鼻から、血を流している。
lines.english: Shinobu touched his face. His hair was a wreck. Blood ran from his mouth and nose.

lines.japanese:
腫れかかっている部分もある。これは処置するこ
とにした。
lines.english: Some places were beginning to swell. Those, he decided to treat.

lines.japanese: 「少し早いが、怪我人が出たので解散する」
lines.english: “It's a little early, but we've got someone hurt. Dismissed.”

lines.japanese:
少年たちは三々五々、外に出て行く。
　こうして見ると、本当にそこいらの学生と変わり
ない。
lines.english: The boys drifted out in twos and threes. Seen like this, they really looked no different from ordinary students.

lines.japanese:
何人かが帽子をむしり取り、長い髪を無造作に垂
らした。
lines.english: Several pulled off their caps and let long hair tumble loosely down.

lines.japanese: 「女の子もいたんだ……」
lines.english: “There were girls here too...”

lines.japanese:
少し驚く。
　気がつかなかった。
lines.english: He was mildly surprised. He had not noticed.

lines.japanese:
長くあけていた古巣は、他人の家のように感じら
れた。
lines.english: After so long away, his old home felt like someone else's house.

lines.japanese: やがて室内には、南と忍だけが残された。
lines.english: Before long, only Minami and Shinobu remained in the room.

lines.japanese: 「……圧勝だったな」
lines.english: “...An overwhelming victory.”

lines.japanese:
「面白いことを言うね。ボロ負けして恥をかかされ
　たのに？」
lines.english: “That's a funny thing to say, considering I lost miserably and got humiliated.”

lines.japanese: 「事実だ」
lines.english: “It's the truth.”

lines.japanese: 当然、といった調子で。
lines.english: His tone said it should be obvious.

lines.japanese: 「……人類最速という噂は、本当らしいな」
lines.english: “...It seems the rumor that you're the fastest man alive was true.”

lines.japanese: 「だから王様なんだろう」
lines.english: “That's why I'm king, I suppose.”

lines.japanese:
「よくわかったもんだ。こちらにアクセスしていた
　ようにも見えなかったけど、してもわかるけど……
　直感かな？」
lines.english: “I'm impressed you noticed. You didn't seem to be accessing me—and I'd have known if you were... Intuition?”

lines.japanese: 「あれだけ動きが変われば、いやでもわかるさ」
lines.english: “When your movements changed that much, I couldn't miss it.”

lines.japanese: 「すぐに制御したんだけど」
lines.english: “I reined it in almost immediately.”

lines.japanese:
「一瞬だけで充分だ。
　あの時……俺も加速していたからな」
lines.english: “A moment was enough. At the time... I was accelerated too.”

lines.japanese:
「相田の拳を捌く手順に、まったく無駄がなかった。
　あれは数手先を呼んだ人間特有の格闘術だ」
lines.english: “There wasn't a single wasted movement in the way you parried Aida's fists. That's the fighting style of someone who's read several moves ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「……彼は気付いたかな」
lines.english: “...Do you think he noticed?”

lines.japanese:
「……気付いたろうな。
　しかし……おまえの負け方もうまかった」
lines.english: “…He probably did. But... you handled losing well, too.”

lines.japanese:
「手心を加えられたと思ったか、あるいは力押しで
　勝ったと感じたか……それは奴次第だが」
lines.english: “Maybe he thought you were going easy on him; maybe he felt he'd won by brute force... That's up to him.”

lines.japanese: 「……なるほど」
lines.english: “...I see.”

lines.japanese: 「ならそんな君から見て、僕の判断はどうだったろう」
lines.english: “Then, given what you saw, what did you think of my decision?”

lines.japanese:
「仮にあそこで善戦ないしは勝利していたら、この
　場にいた大半がおまえへのリンチに加わっていた
　可能性がある」
lines.english: “Had you put up a good fight or actually won, most of the people in that room might have joined in and beaten you down.”

lines.japanese: 「……忠実な臣民に恵まれて嬉しいよ」
lines.english: “...How gratifying to have such loyal subjects.”

lines.japanese: 「精神的に安定していない者もいるのでな」
lines.english: “Some of them aren't mentally stable.”

lines.japanese: 「ほどよい結末だったわけだ」
lines.english: “So it ended about as well as it could have.”

lines.japanese:
皮肉に応じようとした南の、視線が忍の口元に縫
いとめられた。
lines.english: Minami looked ready to answer the sarcasm, but his gaze snagged on Shinobu's mouth.

lines.japanese: 「……もうあざが消えているな」
lines.english: “...The bruising is already gone.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese:
「今の格闘でできた怪我も消えている。
　五分も経ってないはずだが」
lines.english: “The injuries from that fight are gone too. It hasn't even been five minutes.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ、そのくらいならね……」
lines.english: “Well, for something that minor...”

lines.japanese:
「脳内物質による間接的ブースト以外の技術による、
　身体強化処置……セレクテッド・チルドレンの特
　質というわけだ」
lines.english: “Physical augmentation through a mechanism other than an indirect boost from neurochemicals... So that's a distinguishing feature of the Selected Children.”

lines.japanese: 「まあこんなものは、おまけ程度だけどね」
lines.english: “This is little more than a bonus, though.”

lines.japanese: 「新陳代謝を加速しているのか？」
lines.english: “Are you accelerating your metabolism?”

lines.japanese: 「それもあるけど、単なる酵素細工の応用だよ」
lines.english: “That's part of it, but it's just an application of enzyme engineering.”

lines.japanese: 「……酵素だと？」
lines.english: “...Enzymes?”

lines.japanese:
「ツールだよ。もちろん君たちも持っているけど、
　僕はよりうまく使う。適応放散を使うためのものだ
　けど、応用すれば他にもいろいろなことができる」
lines.english: “They're tools. You all have them too, of course; I just use mine better. They're meant to enable adaptive radiation, but they can be adapted to do all sorts of other things.”

lines.japanese: 「適応放散？」
lines.english: “Adaptive radiation?”

lines.japanese: 「……超必殺技ってところかね。時間かかるけど」
lines.english: “...My ultimate move, more or less. Takes a while, though.”

lines.japanese: 「即効性のものもあるけどね」
lines.english: “I do have a few things with an immediate effect.”

lines.japanese: 「…………やはりおまえは……」
lines.english: “...You really are...”

lines.japanese:
優れた現象行使者は根元となる物理への干渉力か
ら、複数の能力系統を分岐させる。
lines.english: From their fundamental ability to interfere with the physical world, accomplished wielders developed several branches of power.

lines.japanese:
つらく厳しいイメージ儀式を通過し、ものにした
ＵＳＥＲは強い。
lines.english: USERs who endured the grueling visualization rituals and made those powers their own were formidable.

lines.japanese:
混沌と煮立った力の源泉から、扱いやすい形で能
力を取り出す。
lines.english: From the chaotic, seething wellspring of power, they drew out abilities in readily usable forms.

lines.japanese:
ＵＳＥＲがそれぞれ確立した力は、いわばアプリ
ケーションソフトだ。
lines.english: The powers each USER established were, so to speak, application software.

lines.japanese: いろいろな能力がある。
lines.english: There were all kinds of abilities.

lines.japanese:
発火。
　風繰り。
lines.english: Ignition. Wind manipulation.

lines.japanese:
肉体干渉。
　念動。
lines.english: Interference with the body. Telekinesis.

lines.japanese:
系統立てて身につけられる現象もいくつか確立さ
れているが、やはり思考が加速するのは当人の資質
に起因するものである。
lines.english: Several phenomena had been established that could be learned systematically, but accelerated thought still derived from an individual's innate gifts.

lines.japanese:
たとえば忍は風を使う。
　風をただ吹かせたり、竜巻を作ったり……その程
度のことしかできないが。
lines.english: Shinobu, for example, could use the wind. All he could do was stir a breeze or form a tornado... nothing beyond that.

lines.japanese:
ＧＶＰの方向性に付随して……異能兵士としての
育成ならびに指導に重点が置かれはじめたのが、い
わゆる南たち第一期の生徒らである。
lines.english: Training began to emphasize the development and instruction of paranormal soldiers, in line with the GVP’s aims... starting with the so-called first cohort, the students of Minami’s generation.

lines.japanese:
末端は末端であれば良いのだが、ついでに兵器で
あれば尚良い道理だ。
lines.english: A terminal only needed to be a terminal. By the same logic, it was even better if it could also serve as a weapon.

lines.japanese:
さらに……ＳＰとして全国に散る機会が増せば、
ＧＶＰ自体の有用性もより高まるという寸法だ。
lines.english: Moreover... the more opportunities they had to disperse nationwide as protection officers, the more useful the GVP itself would become.

lines.japanese:
黎明期終盤の献体であった忍は、そういった直接
戦闘に関わる訓練・技術とは遠いのである。
lines.english: Shinobu had been a test subject near the end of that pioneering period, far removed from training and techniques for direct combat.

lines.japanese: 「風を扱い、治癒能力を持つか」
lines.english: “So you can command the wind and heal.”

lines.japanese: 「……神経加速くらいはできるよ」
lines.english: “...I can at least accelerate my nervous system.”

lines.japanese: 憮然と、忍。
lines.english: Shinobu scowled.

lines.japanese:
「呼吸のできない人間はいないさ。まあ、おまえた
　ちの世代で無作為に研究された、そのフィードバッ
　クが俺たちである以上……」
lines.english: “There isn't a human being who can't breathe. Still, given that we are the product of everything learned through the haphazard research conducted on your generation...”

lines.japanese:
「力が多岐にわたっているのも、当然と言えば当然
　なんだが」
lines.english: “I suppose it's only natural that our powers cover such a broad range.”

lines.japanese: 「他には、何かできるのか？」
lines.english: “What else can you do?”

lines.japanese:
「まあ……細々といろいろあるけど。
　毒素の中和とかさ」
lines.english: “Well... I can do all sorts of little things. Neutralize toxins, for example.”

lines.japanese:
「痛覚を切ったり、興奮剤を多めに分泌させたり……
　内分泌系はまあまあ得意だよ」
lines.english: “Turn off pain, increase stimulant secretion... I'm fairly good with the endocrine system.”

lines.japanese: 「ラボラトリー能力だな、それなら俺も持っている」
lines.english: “Those are laboratory capabilities. I have them too.”

lines.japanese: 「クラスＡ＋の基礎仕様だったっけね」
lines.english: “Wasn't that part of the Class A+ baseline?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「苦痛はなるべく感じるようにしているけどね」
lines.english: “I make a point of feeling pain whenever I can, though.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだな。それは賢明だ」
lines.english: “Yes. That's wise.”

lines.japanese:
痛覚をコントロールできる兵士は強い。
　だとするならば、
lines.english: A soldier who could control pain was strong. If so—

lines.japanese: 「……実は、加速抜きでも善戦はできたということか」
lines.english: “...So you could have held your own even without acceleration.”

lines.japanese: 「それは無理だよ」
lines.english: “No, I couldn't.”

lines.japanese:
「技術が違いすぎる。
　あんなデタラメなのは、僕は知らない」
lines.english: “The gap in technique is too wide. I've never dealt with anything that absurd.”

lines.japanese: 「風抜き、加速抜きだと、そうたいしたことは……」
lines.english: “Without the wind or acceleration, I'm not much—”

lines.japanese: つま先。顎。
lines.english: Toes. Jaw.

lines.japanese:
床に座った姿勢のまま、忍は身をよじる。かろう
じて回避。
lines.english: Still seated on the floor, Shinobu wrenched his body aside. He barely evaded it.
“What the—!”

lines.japanese: 再度、蹴り。今度は避けられない。
lines.english: Another kick. This time he could not evade it.

lines.japanese: オートアーミング―――
lines.english: Auto-Arming—

lines.japanese: 忍は瞬間的に能力を行使していた。
lines.english: Shinobu had activated his ability in that instant.

lines.japanese:
身体防御に関する本能動作が極限まで理論化され、
定められる。
lines.english: The body's instinctive defensive motions were analyzed to their theoretical limit and codified.

lines.japanese:
四肢に限定した、コンディション・シフトが実行
される。
lines.english: A Condition Shift confined to his four limbs was executed.

lines.japanese: 多少、時間と負担がかかる。約０．４秒。
lines.english: It imposed some strain and took a little time. About 0.4 seconds.

lines.japanese:
以降、忍の筋肉はリミッターを外した過負荷行動
にも耐え切る状態に変性させられる。
lines.english: From that point on, Shinobu's muscles were altered to withstand the overload of movement with their limiters removed.

lines.japanese: 最後は胴体。臓器を粘膜状の万能細胞が包む。
lines.english: Last came the torso. A mucous-membrane-like layer of pluripotent cells enveloped his organs.

lines.japanese:
非常に時間がかかる。２～４秒。結果、臓器の耐
久性が飛躍的に向上する。
lines.english: This took a very long time: two to four seconds. As a result, the durability of his organs increased dramatically.

lines.japanese: 制御中枢、四肢、胴体。
lines.english: Control center. Limbs. Torso.

lines.japanese:
それらのプロセスを経て、忍の物理セキュリティ・
レベルは倍加する。
lines.english: Once those processes were complete, Shinobu's physical security level doubled.

lines.japanese: 迫るつま先を、受け流す。
lines.english: He swept the oncoming foot aside.

lines.japanese:
体勢を崩す南。警戒し、後退。
　このあたりで万能細胞ジェル（ＥＳセル）が臓器
をガードし終える。
lines.english: Minami lost his balance. Wary now, he retreated. By then, the pluripotent stem-cell gel (ES cells) had finished shielding Shinobu's organs.

lines.japanese: 「それは……何が起きている？」
lines.english: “What... is going on?”

lines.japanese: 「……いろいろと。自分でも制御できてないけど」
lines.english: “...A lot. I can't control all of it myself, though.”

lines.japanese: 渋面で応える。
lines.english: He answered with a grimace.

lines.japanese:
南は両手をおろす。
　敵意が目に見えて抜けていった。
lines.english: Minami lowered both hands. The hostility visibly drained out of him.

lines.japanese:
「驚いたな。明らかに、さっきまでとも違う。まる
　で武術の達人のような―――」
lines.english: “Well, that was a surprise. You’re clearly different again. Almost like a master martial artist—”

lines.japanese: スナップをきかせ、腰の下あたりから何かを投じた。
lines.english: With a snap of his wrist, he flung something from just below his waist.

lines.japanese: コインだ。
lines.english: A coin.

lines.japanese:
忍の眉間に飛ぶ。
　高速。
　死角。
lines.english: Straight for the spot between Shinobu's eyes. Fast. From his blind spot.

lines.japanese: 難なくガード。だが自らの腕で、視界がふさがれる。
lines.english: He blocked it with ease. But his own arm cut off his view.

lines.japanese:
同時に放たれた南の上段蹴りを視認できなくなる。
　そして次の瞬間、
　天井を見上げていた。
lines.english: The high kick Minami had launched at the same time vanished from sight. And in the next instant, he was staring up at the ceiling.

lines.japanese: 南レイが―――
lines.english: Rei Minami—

lines.japanese: 南は。
lines.english: Minami was—

lines.japanese: 「なん、だと？」
lines.english: “What... was that?”

lines.japanese:
忍がやったのは、蹴りが伸びきった瞬間に、足首
を瞬間的に引いただけである。
lines.english: All Shinobu had done was tug Minami's ankle for an instant the moment the kick reached full extension.

lines.japanese: 回避と同時にそれは実行された。
lines.english: He had done it in the same motion as the dodge.

lines.japanese:
体勢の崩れに勢いが加わり、南は仰臥する形で転
倒したのだ。
lines.english: Momentum compounded the loss of balance, and Minami had gone flat on his back.

lines.japanese:
驚くべきはプロセスではない。
　実行し、実現するタイミングと呼吸だ。
　それはすでに、達人の域である。
lines.english: What was remarkable was not the method itself. It was the timing and rhythm that made the move work. Those were already the skills of a master.

lines.japanese: 「自動防御プログラムだよ」
lines.english: “It's an automated defense program.”

lines.japanese: 「自動……だと？」
lines.english: “Automated...?”

lines.japanese:
「まあ、いくつかの細々とした力を組み合わせまと
　めたものだけど……厳密には一個の能力というよ
　り、複合微細能力プログラムだよ」
lines.english: “Well, it bundles several minor powers together... Strictly speaking, it's less one ability than a program composed of multiple micro-abilities.”

lines.japanese:
「軽度の身体強化と、軽度の肉体変異と、自己暗示的
　なモーション・トレーニングのインプット」
lines.english: “Mild physical enhancement, minor bodily alteration, and motion training implanted through autosuggestion.”

lines.japanese:
「加速は負担が大きいから連用は難しいけど、これは
　体や脳への負担は少ないんだ」
lines.english: “Acceleration is too taxing to use repeatedly, but this puts very little strain on the body or brain.”

lines.japanese:
「あと視覚情報からの発火に連動しているので、より
　上位の優先行動を実行していない時はオートで
　スイッチが入る」
lines.english: “And because it's triggered by visual input, it switches on automatically whenever I'm not performing an action with a higher priority.”

lines.japanese:
「要するに、ぼーっとしてる時は体が危険に対して
　敏感になって、うまく防御してくれるってことだ
　よ」
lines.english: “Basically, when I'm spacing out, my body becomes alert to danger and handles my defense for me.”

lines.japanese:
「……訓練なしで、そういう並はずれた真似が実現
　できるわけか」
lines.english: “...So you can pull off something that extraordinary without training.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ」
lines.english: “More or less.”

lines.japanese: 「なぜさっき使わなかった？」
lines.english: “Why didn't you use it before?”

lines.japanese:
「攻撃プログラム・モジュール作ってないから……
　反撃できないんだ」
lines.english: “I never made an attack program module... so I can’t strike back.”

lines.japanese: 少しだけ羞恥を含ませて、忍は答えた。
lines.english: Shinobu answered with a trace of embarrassment.

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 「悪かった。この訓練は終わりだ」
lines.english: “Sorry. This training session is over.”

lines.japanese: 退出する直前、

lines.japanese:
「長い黎明期を経て、ようやく辿り着いた人類の先

　……」
lines.english: “After that long dawn, humanity finally produced its vanguard: the first generation of USERs. I belong to that generation ...but—”

lines.japanese: 「案外、それは誇るべきことではないのかも知れん」

lines.japanese:
「去勢されていないおまえの本当の力なら、あるい

lines.japanese: 「できないよ」

lines.japanese: 言葉を遮られて、南は少し項垂れたように見えた。

lines.japanese: 「……そうか」

lines.japanese: 扉が開いて、閉まった。

たった一人、忍は無機的な部屋に残される。

lines.japanese: 今の攻防では、まったく過負荷を受けていない。

lines.japanese:
疼痛はじきに治癒されるだろう。

はない。

くぅ、と生理的な音がした。

lines.japanese: 「……おなか、減ったな……」

遅れて顔を出した食堂は、すでに閑散としていた。

その数は十人もいない。

券売機に向かうと、コイン投入口がロックされて

定食とライス大盛りのパネルを押す。二枚の食券

lines.japanese:
不思議なことに、それで全部のメニューに赤ラン
プがついてしまった。

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　どこが？」

lines.japanese: 「ほら」

lines.japanese: 券売機を見て、

lines.japanese: 「んー」

lines.japanese: と喉を鳴らす。そして。

lines.japanese: 少女はつばをくい、と持ち上げて、忍を見た。

lines.japanese: （青い？）
lines.english: (Blue?)

lines.japanese: 「あー、君かあ」
lines.english: “Oh, it's you.”

lines.japanese: 帽子を取る。
lines.english: She removed the cap.

lines.japanese:
長い金髪が、さらっと流れ落ちた。

lines.english: Long blond hair spilled free. The girl looked like an exquisitely crafted doll. Something clicked in Shinobu's mind.
“Oh... you're...!”

lines.japanese:
後ずさり、背中が券売機に当たる。
　そんな様子を見てくすくすと笑ってから、少女は
とろんと半眼にまぶたを落とし、悪戯めかせて、
lines.english: He backed into the ticket machine. She watched him, giggling, then let her lids droop into a drowsy, teasing half-squint and—

lines.japanese: 「その節はどーも」
lines.english: “Thanks for the other day.”

lines.japanese:
くすくすと笑った。
　忘れもしない。
lines.english: She giggled. He could never have forgotten her.

lines.japanese: 「あの時の……変人」
lines.english: “The weirdo... from before.”

lines.japanese: 「ジーンだってば」
lines.english: “I told you, it's Gene.”

lines.japanese: けたけたと笑う。
lines.english: She cackled.

lines.japanese:
ふざけてはいるが、かなりの使い手だ。
　受ける密度や気配だけなら、南レイにも匹敵する
かも知れない。
lines.english: For all her clowning, she was remarkably skilled. Going by sheer density and presence, she might even rival Rei Minami.

lines.japanese: 当然、現象行使の面では忍より格段に上だろう。
lines.english: Naturally, when it came to wielding phenomena, she was likely on an entirely different level from Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「そっか、ここに来てるんだったね。忘れてた」
lines.english: “Oh, right. You did come here. Forgot.”

lines.japanese: 幸い、敵意はないようだ。
lines.english: Fortunately, she did not appear hostile.

lines.japanese: 「……当然か」
lines.english: “...Of course.”

lines.japanese: 自分が、彼女たちの軍門に下ったことを思い出す。
lines.english: He remembered that he had surrendered to her faction.

lines.japanese: 「さっきの訓練にも？」
lines.english: “Were you at the training just now?”

lines.japanese: 「あれはサボった」
lines.english: “I skipped it.”

lines.japanese:
わりと破天荒なことを言う。
　いかにも組織には馴染まないタイプだ。
　瞳には、悪戯めいた光が宿る。
lines.english: That was a fairly outrageous thing to admit. She was plainly not the type to fit into an organization. A mischievous light shone in her eyes.

lines.japanese:
光の下で見る少女は、プラスチックの人形めいて
いた。
lines.english: Seen beneath the lights, the girl looked like a plastic doll.

lines.japanese:
「ジーン・ブランシェット。キンパだけど実質、
　日本人だから」
lines.english: “Gene Blanchett. Blond on top, but Japanese where it counts.”

lines.japanese:
「つっても、血はモンゴロイド入ってないけど。
　つっても、心はサムライだけど。キミ血液型は？」
lines.english: “I mean, I haven't got any Mongoloid blood in me. I mean, my heart's pure samurai. What's your blood type?”

lines.japanese: 「貴宮忍だよ……」
lines.english: “I'm Shinobu Atemiya...”

lines.japanese: 「知ってる。王様ね。ちょっとどいてくれる？」
lines.english: “I know. The king, right? Scoot over a little.”

lines.japanese:
忍が慌てて横にずれると、ジーンは券売機の前に
立ってボタンを押した。
lines.english: Shinobu hurried aside, and Gene stepped up to the ticket machine and pressed a button.

lines.japanese: 売り切れランプは消えていた。
lines.english: The sold-out lights were gone.

lines.japanese: 「これね、必要量以上は買えないようになってんの」
lines.english: “See, it won't let you buy more than you need.”

lines.japanese:
「君は大盛りにしちゃったから、それでもうバツな
　わけ。血液型は？」
lines.english: “You ordered a large, so that used up your whole allowance. What's your blood type?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……そうなんだ」
lines.english: “Oh... I see.”

lines.japanese: 「なにしょんぼりしてんの、おっかしー！」
lines.english: “Why so crushed? That's hilarious!”

lines.japanese:
ジーンは呵々と笑う。
　静まった食堂には、響きすぎる。
　だが狼藉者に対する視線は感じない。
lines.english: Gene let out a peal of laughter. It rang far too loudly through the silent cafeteria. Yet no one glared at her for the disturbance.

lines.japanese: 二人のやりとりを、誰も気にしていない。
lines.english: No one paid any attention to the two of them.

lines.japanese: 「……食いしん坊の一族？」
lines.english: “...Family of gluttons?”

lines.japanese: 「違う」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese:
否定してから、適切ではないことに、遅れて気づ
いた。
lines.english: Only after denying it did he realize that was not quite the right answer.

lines.japanese: 「そうかも」
lines.english: “Maybe.”

lines.japanese: 「面白い子だな。血液型をきこうか？」
lines.english: “You're an interesting kid. Now, let's hear that blood type.”

lines.japanese: 肩を強く叩かれる。
lines.english: She smacked him hard on the shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「オーケー、ともに食事を摂ろう」
lines.english: “Okay. Let us dine together.”
“What?”

lines.japanese:
ただひたすらに食器を運ぶ。
　食器と箸が触れる硬質の音だけだ。
lines.english: Their utensils moved endlessly back and forth. Nothing but the hard click of chopsticks against dishes.

lines.japanese:
ジーンと名乗った少女と同席して（させられて）
はみたものの、会話はない。
lines.english: He had taken a seat (been made to take one) with the girl who called herself Gene, but neither of them spoke.

lines.japanese:
見れば、彼女はピラフに混入されたグリーンピース
を取りのぞくという、不穏な行為に夢中だ。
lines.english: When he looked over, she was absorbed in the ominous business of picking the green peas out of her pilaf.

lines.japanese:

だろうか？

lines.japanese: 少なくとも、当時は食堂なんてものはなかった。

lines.japanese:
部屋で一人、仕事のように食べていたように思う。
　定められた滋養を、最も効率的に吸収できる形。
粘土のようなペースト。
lines.english: He seemed to remember eating alone in his room, as though it were work. The prescribed nutrients, in the form most efficiently absorbed. A paste like clay.

lines.japanese:
感情に乏しい忍は、無味の食品でも食することが
できた。
lines.english: Shinobu had little emotion, and could eat even flavorless food.

lines.japanese:
今思えば、あの厳密に計測された食事には、特殊
な成分が入っていたのだろう。
lines.english: Looking back, those precisely measured meals must have contained special ingredients.

lines.japanese:
だから忍は、他の人間とともに食事を摂る機会を
持たなかった。
lines.english: That was why Shinobu had never had the chance to eat with anyone else.

lines.japanese: 「……食べないの？」
lines.english: “...Aren't you going to eat?”

lines.japanese: ピラフを頬張りながら、ジーンが言った。

lines.japanese:
外見は人形のような少女だが……その振るまいは、
北海道の実家で通信教育を受ける垢抜けない田舎娘
級のがさつさだった。
lines.english: A doll to look at... but as coarse as an unsophisticated country girl taking correspondence courses at her family home in Hokkaido.

lines.japanese: 「おいしそうじゃない」

lines.japanese:
食べながら喋る。
　盛大な咀嚼音。

lines.japanese: いやになるくらい下品。
lines.english: Disgustingly vulgar.

lines.japanese:
「食欲ないのにどうして大盛りなんて頼むかな。も

lines.english: “Are you from around here?”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん……クシュンッ！」

ごはんつぶが飛んだ。

lines.japanese: 「あははははは」

lines.japanese: 「……もぐもぐ」

lines.japanese:
そんな特徴が、ＵＳＥＲには多く見られる。

lines.english: “Paste and unleavened bread... There wasn’t much elaborate cooking involved.”

lines.japanese: 「特殊な調整が必要だったから」
lines.english: “Special adjustments were needed.”

lines.japanese:
「あんま特別扱いされてるもんだからビフテキとか

lines.english: “They give you such special treatment, I figured you ate biftek and stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそれ……」
lines.english: “What does that even mean...?”

lines.japanese:
「ビーフテキーラ？　ビーフテキサスとか……まあ

lines.english: “Beef tequila? Beef Texas... maybe some word like that. Dunno. Meat, anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ビフテキの意味は訊いてない」
lines.english: “I wasn’t asking what ‘biftek’ means.”

lines.japanese:
「……しかも間違ってるし。ただのビーフステーキ

lines.english: “...And you’re wrong. It’s just ‘beef steak.’ Anyway, aren’t you American?”

lines.japanese:
「荒ぶる魂は日本人だっての。あまり聞かない言葉
　だから知らないかなって思ってさ。どうせ人権な

lines.english: “I told you, my raging soul is Japanese. I figured you might not know it since nobody says it much. None of us have human rights anyway, so who cares about nationality?”

lines.japanese: 「箸も使えないような人間が日本人を名乗る」
lines.english: “And someone who can't even use chopsticks calls herself Japanese.”

lines.japanese:
「え？　箸って使える方がスク水……じゃなくて少
　ないよ、あたしらの世代って」
lines.english: “What? People who can use chopsticks are school-swimsuit—no, scarce, in our generation.”

lines.japanese: 「何言ってるんだ君は？」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「え、本当だって」
lines.english: “What? It's true.”

lines.japanese:
「そうだね……１８歳の学生１００人にアンケートを

lines.english: “Let's see... ask a hundred eighteen-year-old students, and thirty or forty of them can't use chopsticks.”

lines.japanese:
「チョップスティックだっけ。いろいろ政治的にも

lines.english: “Chopsticks, right? There are all these political complications too, so forget it. Did they really let education get that lax?”

lines.japanese: 「……なんでそんなことが起こるんだ」
lines.english: “...How does something like that happen?”

lines.japanese:

lines.english: “Their parents don’t teach them, obviously. And there aren’t many chances to use chopsticks in the thirst place. School lunches use spoons, and home cooking vanished a quarter century ago.”

lines.japanese:
「家庭で箸使わなかったら、学校の学食くらいから
　しか習得のチャンスないし。つっても、誰も使わ
　ないけど」
lines.english: “If you don't use them at home, the school cafeteria is about your only chance to learn. Not that anyone there uses them.”

lines.japanese:
その通りだった。
　なおジーンの提示したデータは事実である。

lines.english: She was right. Incidentally, the figures Gene had given were accurate. It sank in.

lines.japanese: 「……うわぁ」
lines.english: “...Oh, wow.”

lines.japanese: 「なんかビフテキって聞くとなんか笑えない？」
lines.english: “Biftek. Doesn’t that sound kind of funny?”

lines.japanese: 「笑えない。何もかも笑えない」
lines.english: “It doesn’t. None of this is funny.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: あとはもう、ひたすら食べ続けた。
lines.english: After that, they did nothing but eat.

lines.japanese: 「しかし君……マイペースだね」
lines.english: “Still... you really do whatever you please.”

lines.japanese:
「そりゃそうさ。強いから。金持ちケンカせず。

lines.english: “Of course. I'm strong. The rich don't fight. You kill the rich and take their money.”

lines.japanese: 「……クラスは？」
lines.english: “...What class are you?”

lines.japanese: 「……なるほど」
lines.english: “...I see.”

lines.japanese:
「巷じゃあジャンキーだのヤク中だの言われ
　てて……」
lines.english: “People call us junkies and druggies and all that...”

lines.japanese:
「やれ麻薬指定された薬が簡単に手に入るとか、そ
　ういうものを公然と使っているとも言われてるけ
　ど……」
lines.english: “They say we can easily get our hands on drugs officially classed as narcotics, and that we use them right out in the open and everything...”

lines.japanese: 「その通りだ」
lines.english: “They're right.”
“Huh!?”

lines.japanese: 「おっとっと。言ったらダメなんだった」
lines.english: “Whoops. Wasn't supposed to say that.”

lines.japanese: 「否定しなさいよ」
lines.english: “You're supposed to deny it.”

「５－Ｍｏｅ－ＤＩＰＴって知ってる？
　甘いよ～、吐くよ～」
lines.english: “Ever heard of 5-Moe-DIPT? Sweet stuff. Makes you puke.”
