lines.japanese: 「いや、知りたくないから」
lines.english: “No, and I don't want to.”

lines.japanese: 「欲しい？」
lines.english: “Want some?”

lines.japanese: 「いらない。トリプタミン系はバランスが崩れる」
lines.english: “No. Tryptamines throw my balance off.”

lines.japanese:
「ああ、セレクトだから薬漬けなんだっけ。つって
　も、知ってるしトリプタミン系だってこと」
lines.english: “Oh, right, you’re Selected, so they keep you pumped full of drugs. I mean, I know it’s a tryptamine.”

lines.japanese:
「……そうだけど合法というか……いや、わからな
　いけど……とにかく自主的に服用するのはまずい
　んだよ」
lines.english: “...They do, but it’s legal, or... no, I don’t know... Anyway, taking drugs on my own is a bad idea.”

lines.japanese: 「鎮痛剤も？」
lines.english: “Even painkillers?”

lines.japanese:
痛いところを突いてきた。
　およそＵＳＥＲであるなら、頭痛とは無縁ではい
られない。
lines.english: She had hit him where it hurt. No USER could remain free of headaches.

lines.japanese:
効果を阻害しない範囲で市販薬を用いることは……
黙認されている。
lines.english: Using over-the-counter drugs, so long as they did not interfere with their abilities... was tacitly permitted.

lines.japanese: 「この対応は、ＡＢ型のものだな」
lines.english: “That response is so type AB.”

lines.japanese: 「……ごはん食べたら？」
lines.english: “...How about eating your food?”

lines.japanese: 「食べてますよ？」
lines.english: “I am eating, you know.”

lines.japanese:
さじを噛む。がじがじと。
　スプーンの尾がこれみよがしに跳ねた。
lines.english: She bit down on her spoon and gnawed. Its handle bobbed ostentatiously.

lines.japanese:
「いや、これがね、いい感じなのよ。エッチ系とい
　うか、皮膚感覚がさ、変わるっていうか」
lines.english: “No, this stuff feels great. Kind of sexy, or like... it changes how your skin feels.”

lines.japanese:
「効いてるときに脚をすりあわせるとね、あ、あたし
　脚が性感帯なんだけど、これがまたキューンという
　感じでついつい漏れちゃうことも―――」
lines.english: “When I rub my legs together while it's working—oh, my legs are an erogenous zone—it feels so good that sometimes I even leak a little—”

lines.japanese: 「黙れよ売女」
lines.english: “Shut up, whore.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　なんだって？」
lines.english: “What? What did you say?”

lines.japanese: つい苛立ちが言葉に出た。
lines.english: His irritation had slipped out.

lines.japanese: 「……いや……なんでもない……」
lines.english: “...Nothing... Never mind...”

lines.japanese:
「ええと、どういう話してたっけ？
　……まあいいや、忘れちゃった」
lines.english: “Wait, what were we talking about? ...Ah, whatever. I forgot.”

lines.japanese: 「ダルダルだよ、君」
lines.english: “You’re a mess.”

lines.japanese: 「思い出した。子供の頃ってなに食べてた？」
lines.english: “I remember. What did you eat as a kid?”

lines.japanese: 「それわざと言っているのか？」
lines.english: “Are you saying that on purpose?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese:
知らぬ顔だ。
　天然らしい。
lines.english: She looked perfectly innocent. Apparently she was like this by nature.

lines.japanese: 「……だから、無酵母パンとペースト食が主だって」
lines.english: “...I told you, mainly unleavened bread and paste.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだっけ」
lines.english: “Oh, was that it?”

lines.japanese:
「野菜もいろいろと刻まれて、まぜられて……雑な
　味だったな。あの中では、まだましだったけど」
lines.english: “All kinds of vegetables were chopped up and mixed in... It tasted pretty rough, though it was one of the better things they gave me.”

lines.japanese: 「わびしいね」
lines.english: “That's bleak.”

lines.japanese:
「……でも、ちょっと安定してくると、研究者の人
　がハンバーガーなんかをこっそり食べさせてくれ
　たことがあったっけ。……あれはうまかったな」
lines.english: “...But once I stabilized a little, one of the researchers would sometimes sneak me a hamburger or something. ...That tasted good.”

lines.japanese: 「ハングリー精神じゃん。苦労してんだ」
lines.english: “A hungry spirit, huh? You’ve had it rough.”

lines.japanese:
「だから……施設にこんな食堂ができてて、ピラフ
　やら定食やらあるのは驚いた」
lines.english: “So... finding a cafeteria here now, with pilaf and set meals and everything, took me by surprise.”

lines.japanese:
「最近はこっちには全然来なかったし、改築していた
　のは知っていたけど……」
lines.english: “I hadn't been over this way at all lately. I knew they were remodeling, but...”

lines.japanese:
「昔に比べれば格段の待遇だと思うし、あの粘土ペー
　ストや味のないパンとは比べようもないとは思うけ
　ど……」
lines.english: “It's a huge improvement over the treatment back then. You can't even compare it to that clay paste and tasteless bread, but...”

lines.japanese: 「いまいち、おいしいと思えなくてね」
lines.english: “Still, it just doesn't taste good to me.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてさ？」
lines.english: “Why not?”

lines.japanese:
「……栄養を整えた食事って、あまり美味くないの
　さ。かえって体に悪いものの方が美味いくらいだ」
lines.english: “...Nutritionally balanced meals don’t taste very good. If anything, the things that are bad for you taste better.”

lines.japanese: 「その不健康な考え方はＢ型っぽくて好きだな」
lines.english: “I like that unhealthy way of thinking. Very type B.”

lines.japanese:
「クラスＳだからって、特別待遇を受けていたわけ
　じゃないんだよ」
lines.english: “Just because I'm Class S doesn't mean I was getting special treatment.”

lines.japanese:
目の前の膳を見下ろす。
　味は決して悪くないはずなのだ。
lines.english: He looked down at the meal before him. It ought to have tasted perfectly fine.

lines.japanese:
だが……環境が変わると、こうも嗜好が変わるも
のだろうか。
lines.english: But... could a new environment really alter a person's tastes so completely?

lines.japanese: 街での暮らしでは、食事は妙に楽しかった。
lines.english: In town, eating had been curiously pleasant.

lines.japanese:
舌を刺激するという行為に、養分以上の価値を見
いだしていた。
lines.english: He had discovered something in the sensation of taste that was worth more than nutrition.

lines.japanese: そして食事をともにする誰かがいた。
lines.english: And there had been someone to share those meals.

lines.japanese:
ぼんやりとした幸せが、そこにあった。
　だからこの食事は、色褪せた栄養補給としか思え
ない。
lines.english: A soft, indistinct happiness had been there. That was why this meal seemed no more than colorless sustenance.

lines.japanese:
食事から色が失われてしまった。
　他人事のようだ。
lines.english: Food had lost its color. As though it had nothing to do with him.

lines.japanese: 灰色の施設。
lines.english: The gray facility.

lines.japanese: 灰色の壁。
lines.english: Gray walls.

lines.japanese: 灰色の食事。
lines.english: Gray food.

lines.japanese: 灰色の仲間。
lines.english: Gray comrades.
“...Hellooo!”

lines.japanese:
眼前をせわしなく往復する白い手に、忍の注意は
引き戻される。
lines.english: A white hand darting back and forth before his eyes drew Shinobu's attention back.

lines.japanese: 「な、なに？」
lines.english: “Wh-what?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、戻ってきた」
lines.english: “Oh, you're back.”

lines.japanese:
「ちょっと旅してたみたいだから、戻してあげたの
　ね」
lines.english: “You looked like you'd gone off on a little trip, so I brought you back.”

lines.japanese: 「……旅がなに？」
lines.english: “...What trip?”

lines.japanese: 「空気読めない子だなあ」
lines.english: “You can’t read a room, can you?”

lines.japanese:
「ここって、けっこういじめとかもあるから……
　そういう感じだと狙われるよ？」
lines.english: “Bullying's pretty common around here... Act like that and somebody will target you.”

lines.japanese: すでに狙われていた。
lines.english: Somebody already had.

lines.japanese: 「君も、そういうことを？」
lines.english: “Do you do that sort of thing too?”

lines.japanese: 「あちし？」
lines.english: “Meeee?”

lines.japanese: 忍は頷く。
lines.english: Shinobu nodded.

lines.japanese: 「その時の気分次第」
lines.english: “Depends how I feel.”

lines.japanese: 否定しなかった。
lines.english: She had not denied it.

lines.japanese: 「……つまらない子だなあ。冗談だって」
lines.english: “...You're boring. I'm kidding.”

lines.japanese: 「え、冗談？」
lines.english: “What? You were joking?”

lines.japanese:
ジーンは肩をすくめた。
　その演技ぶった態度だけならば、生来の米国人に
見えた。
lines.english: Gene shrugged. Going by that theatrical gesture alone, she looked every inch a native-born American.

lines.japanese: 「ま、そういうキャラも必要だよね、集団には」
lines.english: “Well, every group needs somebody like you.”

lines.japanese:
「よくわからないけど……要するに君は変わり者な
　んだな」
lines.english: “I don’t really understand... but what it comes down to is, you’re an odd one.”

lines.japanese: 「たは。まあヘンてのは事実だけどね」
lines.english: “Hah. Well, weird is true enough.”

lines.japanese:
「頭がね、ちょっとね、バッドトリップなのだな。
　オーバードーズした時みたいにさ」
lines.english: “My brain’s on a bit of a bad trip, you know. Like when you overdose.”

lines.japanese: 自分の頭を、銃で撃ち抜くように指さす。
lines.english: She pointed at her own head as though putting a bullet through it.

lines.japanese: 「おかげで制御系がおかしい」
lines.english: “So my control systems are screwed up.”

lines.japanese:
「すごーく興奮すると、なぜかうまく制御できるん
　だよね……まあ、アレよ。追いつめられないと力
　を発揮できないタイプ」
lines.english: “For some reason, I can control it when I get really, really worked up... You know the type. Can't show what I'm made of until I'm cornered.”

lines.japanese: 「能力を訊く……のはまずいんだろうね」
lines.english: “I probably shouldn't ask... what your ability is.”

lines.japanese: 「さすがにね。企業秘密」
lines.english: “Yeah, that one's off-limits. Trade secret.”

lines.japanese:
「しかし、君もなんか線が細いよね。もっと屈強な
　人かと思ってた。狼みたいな」
lines.english: “Still, you're pretty slight yourself. I pictured somebody tougher. Wolfish.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……むしろ南や彼の部下のイメージだな」
lines.english: “That sounds... more like Minami and his men to me.”

lines.japanese: 「レイと相田か。うん、あれは狼だね」
lines.english: “Rei and Aida? Yeah, they're wolves.”

lines.japanese:
「どうも二人には嫌われているらしいよ。温室育ち
　の僕は」
lines.english: “Apparently those two don't care for me—hothouse flower that I am.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうだね。よく言ってた。本人たちも」
lines.english: “Yeah, that's right. They say it all the time themselves.”

lines.japanese: 彼女に、大切な話をするのはやめた方が良さそうだ。
lines.english: It seemed best not to discuss anything important with her.

lines.japanese: 「……まあ、当然だろうけどね」
lines.english: “...Well, I suppose it's only natural.”

lines.japanese:
「あたしたちは、ずっと聖戦に参加するんだって教育
　されてきたからね」
lines.english: “We were always taught that we'd take part in a holy war.”

lines.japanese: 忍の箸が止まる。
lines.english: Shinobu's chopsticks stopped.

lines.japanese: 「聖戦？」
lines.english: “A holy war?”
“Uh-huh.”

lines.japanese: その時だけ、ジーンは少し遠い目をした。
lines.english: For that moment alone, Gene's eyes went a little distant.

lines.japanese: 「せいなるたたかい。ちょーせいぎ」
lines.english: “A ho-ly battle. Suuuper righteous.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……どういう意味で使われていたの？」
lines.english: “What... did they mean by that?”

lines.japanese:
「うん。世界を救うには、統一国家を作るしかない
　みたいな考えがあったじゃない？」
lines.english: “You know. There was that idea that saving the world meant creating a single unified nation, right?”

lines.japanese: 「……あったけど」
lines.english: “...There was, yes.”

lines.japanese:
「そのための戦いがあるんじゃないかって、みんな
　言ってた」
lines.english: “Everyone said there might be a war to bring it about.”

lines.japanese: 「西側諸国と戦うって？」
lines.english: “A war against the Western nations?”

lines.japanese:
「だって、私たちみたいのが作られるって、異常な
　ことだよ。普通じゃない」
lines.english: “Making people like us is insane. It isn’t normal.”

lines.japanese:
「法律いじって、施設作って、福祉事業ってカラつ
　けて孤児集めてさ……んで人体実験だよ？
　戦闘訓練だよ？」
lines.english: “They fiddle with the law, build facilities, collect orphans under the cover of welfare work... then human experiments? Combat training?”

lines.japanese: 「ほんと、正気の沙汰は金次第だね」
lines.english: “Even sanity bends to money.”

lines.japanese: 「地獄の沙汰」
lines.english: “Hell, not sanity.”

lines.japanese: 「絶対に、戦争だって思ってたのにな」
lines.english: “I was so sure there'd be a war.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、戦争はなかなか起こらなかった」
lines.english: “But the war just wouldn't come.”

lines.japanese:
「で、もしかすると……私たちって、単に商品とし
　て売りさばかれるだけなのかなーって思ってたと
　ころで、この騒ぎ」
lines.english: “So right when I was starting to wonder... if maybe they'd just sell us off as merchandise, all this happened.”

lines.japanese: 「みんな、テンション下げてたんだよねー」
lines.english: “We were all getting pretty bummed out, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「戦争をしなくて良かったのに？」
lines.english: “Even though it was good there hadn't been a war?”

lines.japanese: 「戦争をしたかった」
lines.english: “We wanted war.”

lines.japanese:
言い切る。
　真剣に、忍を射竦めた。
lines.english: She said it without hesitation. Her eyes turned grave and pinned Shinobu in place.

lines.japanese:
「そのために生まれてきたんだから。普通も知らず
　に」
lines.english: “It's what we were born for. Never even knowing what normal was.”

lines.japanese: 「せめて、自分の力に酔いたかったんだよ、みんな」
lines.english: “All of us wanted at least the chance to get drunk on our own power.”

lines.japanese: 「君にはわからないかもしれない」
lines.english: “Maybe you wouldn't understand.”

lines.japanese: 「大きな流れに飛び込めないって気分は」
lines.english: “What it feels like when you can't throw yourself into the great current.”

lines.japanese:
「それだけが、あたしたちの全てだったのに。いっ
　たいいつ？　いつまで待てば、あたしたちは試せ
　るの？」
lines.english: “It was everything to us. So when? How long do we have to wait before we can put ourselves to the test?”

lines.japanese: 「いつになったら……スカッとできるのよ？」
lines.english: “When do we finally get to... cut loose?”

lines.japanese: 「……そうだね、僕にはわからない」
lines.english: “...You're right. I don't understand.”

lines.japanese: 「おぼっちゃん」
lines.english: “Spoiled little boy.”

lines.japanese:
肘をついたジーンが、真横から妖しい視線を忍に
向けた。
lines.english: Propped on one elbow, Gene gave Shinobu an uncanny sidelong look.

lines.japanese:
侮辱されているようでもあり、からかわれている
ようでもある。
lines.english: She might have been insulting him, or she might have been teasing.

lines.japanese:
「……もしかして、南に言われたから話しかけてき
　た？」
lines.english: “...Did you come talk to me because Minami told you to?”

lines.japanese: 「どうして？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese:
「斥候でもしてるのかなって。あの連中の代表とし
　て」
lines.english: “I wondered if you were doing reconnaissance. On behalf of that group.”

lines.japanese: 「……あー、ハズレ。だけど偶然じゃないけどね」
lines.english: “...Nope. Wrong guess. But it wasn’t a coincidence.”

lines.japanese:
「誰も君に触れようとしないから、だからあたしが
　試したんだ」
lines.english: “Nobody else would lay a hand on you, so I tested you myself.”

lines.japanese:
「あいつら……ちょっと“遅い”からさ、仲間とつ
　るみすぎて鈍ってんのさ。やりたいようにやるの
　があたしらなのに」
lines.english: “Those guys are a little too 'slow.' Running with the pack has dulled them. We're supposed to do whatever we want.”

lines.japanese:
「そうじゃないと、スピードに乗れないよ。だから
　あいつらはスロウなんだ。Ａ型やＡＢ型なんだ」
lines.english: “Otherwise you can't get up to speed. That's why they're slow. They're type A and type AB.”

lines.japanese:
「ねえ、戦争はやっぱりあるんでしょ？　だからう
　ちらが集められたわけなんでしょ？」
lines.english: “There is going to be a war, right? That's why they've gathered us here, right?”

lines.japanese: 「敵も味方も規模も状況も……何もかもが不明」
lines.english: “The enemy, our allies, the scale, the circumstances... all unknown.”

lines.japanese: 「でもあたしらは知ってる。なんでだと思う？」
lines.english: “But we know. Guess why.”

lines.japanese:
「１１年前に命令が来たからだよ。備えろって。
　戦いに、備えろって。だからみんな高ぶってる」
lines.english: “Because an order came eleven years ago. Prepare, it said. Prepare for battle. That's why everyone's so worked up.”

lines.japanese:
「聖戦に参加できるから、どんな苦しみにも耐えら
　れる。つっても、脱落したのも多いけど」
lines.english: “If we get to join the holy war, we can bear any suffering. I mean, plenty did drop out.”

lines.japanese:
「時間がたって、当時の情報もだいぶ検討されたん
　だよ。君は知ってるかな？　どうかな？　ネット
　は見てる？　どうかな？」
lines.english: “Time passed, and people went over the information from back then pretty thoroughly. Do you know about it? Do you? Do you use the net? Do you?”

lines.japanese: 「ネット？」
lines.english: “The net?”

lines.japanese:
「１１年前のウェブって、全然薄かったでしょ？
　なのに当時、あれだけの高密度の情報を発した人
　間がいたんだ」
lines.english: “The web was awfully thin eleven years ago, right? But even then, somebody transmitted information that dense.”

lines.japanese: 「それを完全に解凍するのに何年もかかったって」
lines.english: “They say fully decompressing it took years.”

lines.japanese:
「順を追って、命令の意図が理解されるようになって
　……それであたしたちは、アンダーなグラウンドで
　それを耳朶に挟む」
lines.english: “Little by little, they came to understand what the order meant... and down in the underground, it reached our earlobes.”

lines.japanese: 「……小耳に挟む」
lines.english: “…Reached our ears.”

lines.japanese:
「すっごいご機嫌なストーリー。ド派手な能力バト
　ル。欧州・アジア連合の策謀。同盟国アメリカの
　思惑」
lines.english: “A real feel-good story. Flashy superpower battles. Schemes by the European-Asian alliance. The designs of our ally, America.”

lines.japanese:
「銃を与えられて戦場に立つのは心壊された少年
　少女。平和な日常を装う人々。着々と準備を進める
　組織。真実を知る者。偽りの真実を知らされる者」
lines.english: “Boys and girls with shattered minds, handed guns and sent to war. People pretending life is peaceful. An organization steadily preparing. Those who know the truth. Those fed a false truth.”

lines.japanese: 「少女の涙。一握りの勇気と無謀。そして―――」
lines.english: “A girl's tears. A little courage, a little recklessness. And—”

lines.japanese: 「主役はどこの馬の骨とも知れない……君だあ」
lines.english: “Our hero is some nobody from God knows where... you!”

lines.japanese:
ウインクとともに忍を指さす。
　決まった。
　一転して真顔に戻り、
lines.english: She winked and pointed at Shinobu. Nailed it. Then her face turned serious again.

lines.japanese: 「歓迎する子がいない理由、おわかりか？」
lines.english: “Now do you understand why nobody welcomed you?”

lines.japanese: 「多少は……」
lines.english: “A bit...”

lines.japanese:
「コマになるのは覚悟してるけど、いてもいなくて
　も一緒ってのは、ひどいよね」
lines.english: “We’re ready to be pawns. But if it makes no difference whether we’re there or not, that’s pretty awful.”

lines.japanese:
「あたしたちだって、人格ある人間なんだからさ。
　じんけんじんけんきほんてきじんけん」
lines.english: “We're people with minds of our own, too. Human rights, human rights, fundamental human rights.”

lines.japanese: 「意思の疎通って、欲しいと思っちゃうよね」
lines.english: “You can’t help wanting communication to go both ways.”

lines.japanese: 「待った。それは今の僕の立場からは―――」
lines.english: “Wait. From my present position—”

lines.japanese:
「ま、いいけどね。きみのせいってわけじゃないだ
　ろうし」
lines.english: “Whatever. It probably isn't your fault.”

lines.japanese: 「それにさ」
lines.english: “Besides—”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「……いてもいなくても一緒ってことより、もっと
　つらいことってあるんじゃないかな」
lines.english: “...Maybe there are worse things than not making a difference whether you’re there or not.”

lines.japanese: 「たとえば」
lines.english: “Such as?”

lines.japanese:
「たとえば……それが本当に自分の心なのかどうか
　わからなくなるとか」
lines.english: “Such as... no longer knowing whether your heart is truly your own.”

lines.japanese: 「……洗脳されたような状況のこと？」
lines.english: “...A situation like being brainwashed?”

lines.japanese: 「気が付いたら、別人にされていました的な」
lines.english: “Like finding out you'd been turned into somebody else.”

lines.japanese: 「彼を好きだったのに、嫌いになっていたとか」
lines.english: “You liked him, but then you found you hated him.”

lines.japanese: 「……嫌いだったのに、好きにされてしまったとか」
lines.english: “...Or you hated him, but were made to like him.”

lines.japanese: 「わかんないよ」
lines.english: “I don't know.”
“...Right.”

lines.japanese: 「変えられた自覚があるとつらいと思う」
lines.english: “I think it would hurt if you were aware you'd been changed.”

lines.japanese: 「え、でも……じゃなかったら平気なの？」
lines.english: “But... if you didn't know, you'd be fine?”

lines.japanese:
「平気も何もわからんのでしょうに。洗脳が認識で
　きない心は、自分自身と変わりないよ」
lines.english: “Fine or not, you'd never know, would you? A brainwashed mind you can't recognize as brainwashed is no different from your own.”

lines.japanese: 「…………ドライだ」
誇るように自分を指す。
lines.english: She pointed proudly at herself.

lines.japanese: 「Ｏ型だからね！」
lines.english: “I'm type O!”

lines.japanese:
「……さてと、そろそろちょっと南に怒られてこよ
　うかなっと。いろいろサボったし、勝手に接触し
　たし」
lines.english: “...Well then, guess I'll go let Minami yell at me a little. I skipped all sorts of things and made contact without permission.”

lines.japanese: 立ち上がる。
lines.english: She stood.
“Ah—” “Ah—”

lines.japanese:
その拍子に、ジーンの肘が忍のライス皿を床に落
とした。
lines.english: As she did, Gene's elbow knocked Shinobu's plate of rice onto the floor.

lines.japanese: 「ごっめーん。かわりにこれあげる」
lines.english: “Sooorry. Here, you can have these instead.”

lines.japanese: 食べ残しのグリーンピースが、忍の器に盛られた。
lines.english: She heaped her leftover green peas onto Shinobu's plate.

lines.japanese: 「ばいばいきーん」
lines.english: “Bye-bye, germy!”

lines.japanese: 風のように去りぬ。
lines.english: Gone like the wind.

lines.japanese: 忍はジーンのことが嫌いになった。
lines.english: Shinobu now disliked Gene.

lines.japanese:
午後。
　招集されることはなかった。
　忍は灰色の部屋で過ごす。
lines.english: Afternoon. No summons came. Shinobu spent it in the gray room.

lines.japanese:
筋力トレーニングでもしようかと思うものの、い
まいち気が乗らない。
lines.english: He considered doing some strength training, but could not quite bring himself to it.
“...Haaah.”

lines.japanese:
それでも未来が輝いていれば、活気を失わずには
済んだかも知れない。
lines.english: Even so, if the future had been bright, perhaps he could have kept his spirits up.

lines.japanese: 忍の目には、絶望だけが鮮明だ。
lines.english: To Shinobu's eyes, only despair stood out clearly.

lines.japanese:
予知にも似た確信が、心に寄生して離れない。
　なぜなら。
lines.english: A certainty like foreknowledge clung to his mind like a parasite and would not let go. Because—

lines.japanese: 忍は目を閉じ、自らを暗黒に置く。
lines.english: Shinobu closed his eyes and placed himself in darkness.

lines.japanese: （見えない……何も）
lines.english: (I can't see... anything.)

lines.japanese:
まぶたの裏には、純度の高い闇がわだかまってい
るだけだ。
lines.english: Nothing but a pool of utterly pure darkness lay behind his eyelids.

lines.japanese: （未来視が……できない……）
lines.english: (I can't... see the future...)

lines.japanese: （近いからか？　近すぎる未来は見えないのか？）
lines.english: (Is it because it’s close? Can’t I see the future when it’s too close?)

lines.japanese:
（……だけどどの道……人は滅びる……
　それが、わかるんだ……僕には―――）
lines.english: (...But either way... humanity will perish... I can feel it... I—)

lines.japanese:
終わってしまった未来から見る今という時間は、
なんと寂れて見えるのだろうか。
lines.english: How desolate the present seemed, viewed from a future that had already ended.

lines.japanese: 再放送された映像記録を思わせる。
lines.english: It was like watching a rerun.

lines.japanese:
好きな映画を何度も見るのは楽しい。
　後味の悪い悲劇は……見直す気にはならない。
lines.english: You could enjoy watching a favorite film over and over. A tragedy that left a foul aftertaste... was not something you wanted to see again.

lines.japanese: （せめて幸福な結末なら……）
lines.english: (If only it had a happy ending...)

lines.japanese:
そして忍は落ち込んでいく。
　戦争が起こっても、忍は人々を守れないだろう。
lines.english: And so Shinobu sank deeper. Even if war came, he probably could not protect the people.

lines.japanese: その罪ならば、背負ってもいい。覚悟はできている。
lines.english: He was willing to bear that guilt. He was ready.

lines.japanese: だが―――
lines.english: But—

lines.japanese: 頭痛がはじまった。
lines.english: The headache had begun.

lines.japanese:
まったくこの苦痛だけは、訪れる時間を選ぶこと
がない。
lines.english: This pain, of all things, never cared what time it was.

lines.japanese:
自由時間だったのは幸いだ。
　身体を激しく動かす訓練時に痛み出したら、たま
ったものではない。
lines.english: It was lucky this had happened during his free time. If it started during strenuous physical training, it would be unbearable.

lines.japanese: 「いてて……くそっ」
lines.english: “Ow, ow... damn it.”

lines.japanese:
ズキズキと、血流に合わせて鈍く痛む。
　鎮痛剤の服用をやめてからこちら、日増しにひど
くなってきているようだ。
lines.english: A dull throb pulsed in time with his blood. Ever since he had stopped taking painkillers, it seemed to be worsening by the day.

lines.japanese: そろそろ処置の必要性を感じる。
lines.english: He was beginning to feel he needed treatment.

lines.japanese:
紛らわすため、考えた。
　気楽なことを考えようとした。
lines.english: He thought, trying to distract himself. He tried to think of something light.
(Wait—)

lines.japanese:
（未来が途絶するビジョンって、世界が消え去るん
　じゃなくて、自分の方が死ぬって可能性もあるな）
lines.english: (A vision of the future cutting off might not mean the world disappears. It might mean I'm the one who dies.)

lines.japanese: （前に視たアレ……確かにどっちとも取れるものだ）
lines.english: (That thing I saw before... could certainly mean either.)

lines.japanese:
世界が喪失するのではなく。
　観測者としての自分が滅びる。
lines.english: Not the world ceasing to exist. Himself—the observer—ceasing to exist.

lines.japanese:
その二つには、どういった差があるのか。認知上
は同一。
lines.english: What difference was there between the two? Perceptually, they were identical.

lines.japanese:
そして忍の認識が失せれば、忍の世界も消えるの
だった。
lines.english: And if Shinobu's awareness vanished, his world would vanish with it.

lines.japanese: 忍は考えてしまった。
lines.english: Shinobu had let himself follow the thought.

lines.japanese: 全然楽にはならなかった。
lines.english: It did not make him feel better at all.

lines.japanese: 「……やめやめ」
lines.english: “...Enough, enough.”

lines.japanese:
詮無い思考。
　根幹である自分がいなくなれば、計画そのものが
破綻する。
lines.english: Useless speculation. If Shinobu himself—the plan's linchpin—ceased to exist, the plan itself would collapse.

lines.japanese:
相手の決断を予測するならいざしらず、あてにす
るのは危険だ。
lines.english: Predicting the enemy's decision was one thing; relying on it was dangerous.

lines.japanese:
敵は手強い。
　滅びが訪れるだろう。
　そのあとは……無だ。
lines.english: The enemy was formidable. Destruction would come. After that... nothing.

lines.japanese:
無の先を考える必要はない。
　自己撞着を起こしてしまう。
lines.english: There was no need to think beyond nothingness. That way lay self-contradiction.

lines.japanese: 電話が鳴った。内線だ。
lines.english: The telephone rang. An internal line.
“...Hello?”

lines.japanese: 『面会の時間です。昨日の部屋まで来てください』
lines.english: “It's time for your meeting. Please come to the same room as yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 胃のあたりが重くなった。
lines.english: A heaviness settled in his stomach.

lines.japanese: 「わかりました。格好は……？」
lines.english: “Understood. What should I wear...?”

lines.japanese: 『そのままで結構です』
lines.english: “What you have on is fine.”

lines.japanese: 「了解です」
lines.english: “Understood.”

lines.japanese: 受話器を置く。
lines.english: He replaced the receiver.

lines.japanese: 「面会……か」
lines.english: “A meeting...”

lines.japanese: きっと無意味に違いないと知っていた。
lines.english: He knew it was bound to be meaningless.

lines.japanese: 扉をノックすると、自動的にロックが解除された。
lines.english: When he knocked, the door unlocked automatically.

lines.japanese:
この部屋は、かなり様々な状況を想定して用意さ
れたものらしい。
lines.english: The room appeared to have been designed for a great many possible situations.

lines.japanese: 「失礼します」
lines.english: “Excuse me.”

lines.japanese: 扉を開く。
lines.english: He opened the door.

lines.japanese: 忍は少なからぬ驚きに見舞われた。
lines.english: Shinobu was more than a little surprised.

lines.japanese:
昨日、千鳥が座っていた向こう側に、恰幅の良い
外国人の男がいた。
lines.english: A portly foreign man sat on the far side, in the place where Chidori had sat the day before.

lines.japanese: 初老。
lines.english: Past middle age.

lines.japanese:
決して派手ではないが、地味とも言えないスーツ
に身を包んでいる。
lines.english: He wore a suit that was neither flamboyant nor plain.

lines.japanese:
独特のオーラを忍は感じた。
　異能力者のそれとは違う、人間としての圧力だ。
lines.english: Shinobu sensed a singular aura. Not the presence of someone with paranormal powers, but the pressure of a human being.

lines.japanese:
男が、かたわらに控える女に耳打ちする。
　女……通訳は、忍の名を確認する。
lines.english: The man whispered to the woman waiting at his side. The woman—his interpreter—asked Shinobu to confirm his name.

lines.japanese: 「はい、自分です」
lines.english: “Yes. That's me.”

lines.japanese:
座った男性は、忍の態度に満足そうに頷き、何事
か短い言葉を発する。
lines.english: The seated man nodded, apparently pleased by Shinobu's manner, and said something brief.

lines.japanese:
それを通訳が日本語にして忍に伝える。
　男は自らの名前と立場を告げた。
lines.english: The interpreter rendered his words into Japanese for Shinobu. The man gave his name and position.

lines.japanese: 「はじめまして」
lines.english: “It's a pleasure to meet you.”

lines.japanese:
差し出した手を握り返す。
　外国人の握手に対する抵抗のなさに、忍は驚いた。
lines.english: The offered hand met an answering grip. Shinobu was surprised at how readily the foreigner shook hands.

lines.japanese:
慣れているということもあるのだろうが、相手に
接触したいという意志が伝わってくるような、力強
い握手だった。
lines.english: Practice probably had something to do with it, but his firm handshake seemed to convey a desire to make contact.

lines.japanese:
男は……忍の手を、自らの両手で覆った。
　向けられる笑顔と熱っぽい響きのイングリッシュ。
lines.english: The man... enclosed Shinobu's hand in both of his. A smile fixed on him, and a fervent stream of English.

lines.japanese:
遅れて変換される言葉を、どこか遠いものとして
忍は聞く。
lines.english: Shinobu heard the words, converted after a delay, as though they came from far away.

lines.japanese:
翻弄される。
　耳に入る翻訳内容を、理解していながら忘却して
いる。
lines.english: He was buffeted. He understood the translated words entering his ears even as he forgot them.

lines.japanese:
言語の奔流が、密閉空間を埋め尽くす。
　文節からへし折れ、語句へと分解され、アトラン
ダムに撒かれた。
lines.english: A torrent of language filled the sealed room. Broken at the joints of its clauses, reduced to words and phrases, then scattered at random.

lines.japanese:
主格を失った動詞と名詞と接続詞。
　それらが蔓延する言語的汚染空間は、息苦しさを
呼び起こすものだった。
lines.english: Verbs, nouns, and conjunctions stripped of their subjects. A space polluted by their linguistic proliferation until it became hard to breathe.

lines.japanese:
頭は理解しているはずなのだ。
　事実、忍はそつなく会話をコントロールしている。
lines.english: His mind should have understood it. In fact, Shinobu was controlling the conversation without a hitch.

lines.japanese:
投げかけられる言葉を、当たり障りのない返答で
受け止め続けている。
lines.english: He continued catching every word thrown at him with an innocuous reply.

lines.japanese:
極めて優秀なはぐらかしを成立させている。
　だが本人の感情部分が、言語回路と接続されてい
ない。
lines.english: His evasions were impeccably skillful. But the emotional part of him was not connected to his language circuits.

lines.japanese:
異星人同士の会話を耳にしたら、こんな気分だろ
うか。
lines.english: Was this how it would feel to overhear a conversation between aliens?

lines.japanese:
経済的な発展。
　戦争からこちら。
　同盟国。
lines.english: Economic growth. Since the war. Allied nations.

lines.japanese:
苦楽をともに。
　今までも。
　これからも。
lines.english: Through thick and thin. Until now. From now on.

lines.japanese:
良い友人。
　公私ともに。
　次の機会には食事。
lines.english: Good friends. In public and private. Dinner next time.

lines.japanese: 夏休みには別荘に招待。
lines.english: An invitation to the villa over summer vacation.

lines.japanese:
懐柔と情報。
　それが、巧妙な弁舌の向かう終着駅だ。
　一国のトップが、異国の少年におべっかを使う。
lines.english: Winning him over. Information. That was the destination of all that artful eloquence. The head of a nation flattering a foreign boy.

lines.japanese:
滑稽だ、と感じる。
　通訳の奏でる雑音が、羽虫の群れと同様の煩わしさ。
lines.english: Absurd, Shinobu thought. The interpreter's noise was as maddening as a swarm of gnats.

lines.japanese:
賛嘆し、手管を尽くし、なんとか笑顔を引き出そ
うと苦心する。
lines.english: Praise upon praise, every artifice exhausted, all in the struggle to draw out a smile.

lines.japanese:
素晴らしい才能。素晴らしい才能。素晴らしい
才能―――
lines.english: Wonderful talent. Wonderful talent. Wonderful talent—

lines.japanese: ひとや

無に耐えられず、事務的な笑みを向ける。
　瞬間、室内が華やいだ。
　語句が増幅し獄と化す。
lines.english: Unable to endure the void, Shinobu offered a professional smile. In that instant, the room blossomed. The words multiplied into a prison.

lines.japanese: 悪夢のような、サイケデリックな喜びに満たされる。
lines.english: The room filled with a nightmarish, psychedelic joy.

lines.japanese:
最良のパートナー。最良のパートナー。
　最良のパートナー―――
lines.english: The finest partner. The finest partner. The finest partner—

lines.japanese:
日米の繁栄。日米の繁栄。日米の繁栄―――
　輝かしい希望。輝かしい希望。輝かしい希望―――
lines.english: Prosperity for Japan and America. Prosperity for Japan and America. Prosperity for Japan and America—Radiant hope. Radiant hope. Radiant hope—
“...Despair.”

lines.japanese:
机の向こう側にも辿り着かない囁き声が、全てを
否定してのけた。
lines.english: The whisper did not even reach the other side of the desk, yet it negated everything.

lines.japanese:
そして忍は、一人でいた。
　観客のない茶番劇は終わっていた。
lines.english: And then Shinobu was alone. The farce without an audience was over.

lines.japanese: 正直、彼らがいつ出て行ったのかも記憶していない。
lines.english: In truth, he did not even remember when they had left.

lines.japanese:
一人だった。
　高性能の空調装置が、空気とともに言語の羽虫た
ちを流し去り、室内はシンとしている。
lines.english: He was alone. The high-performance air conditioner swept the linguistic gnats away with the air, leaving the room silent.

lines.japanese: やがて反対側の扉が開くと、千鳥が姿を見せた。
lines.english: Eventually, the door on the opposite side opened and Chidori appeared.

lines.japanese: 「忍、終わりましたよ？」
lines.english: “Shinobu, it's over.”

lines.japanese:
うなだれて、反応を見せない忍。
　千鳥の眉根が寄った。
lines.english: Shinobu hung his head and gave no response. Chidori's brows drew together.
“Shinobu?”

lines.japanese:
「……あの国は、僕を受け入れる準備があるそうで
　す」
lines.english: “...I hear that country is prepared to accept me.”

lines.japanese:
唐突な言葉。
　口止めされた言葉。
lines.english: Abrupt words. Words he had been forbidden to repeat.
“...I see.”

lines.japanese:
モニターされていないという約束を、彼らがどれ
だけ信じていたかは知らない。
lines.english: He had no idea how much they believed the assurance that they were not being monitored.

lines.japanese:
されていても、同様の言葉を投げかけたかも知れ
ない。
lines.english: They might have made the same offer even if they were.

lines.japanese:
「その見返りは、大金と豪邸と大統領の友人として
　の資格と社交界ならびに政界へのデビューとより
　どりみどりの女性だそうですよ」
lines.english: “In return, they offer a great deal of money, a mansion, the status of being the president's friend, a debut in high society and politics, and my choice of women.”

lines.japanese: 乾いて、情のない口調。
lines.english: A dry tone, devoid of feeling.

lines.japanese: 「そう」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
「日本は危険な立場に置かれているそうです。特に
　要人が生活するには、いろいろと不都合があると
　のことです」
lines.english: “Apparently Japan is in a dangerous position. In particular, it poses all kinds of problems as a place for important figures to live.”

lines.japanese: 「そう」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
「近いですから。アジアのいくつかの好戦的な国と
　も」
lines.english: “Because we’re close. Close to several belligerent countries in Asia, too.”

lines.japanese:
「だから一度、視察の意味もかねて米国に観光に来
　ないかと誘われました」
lines.english: “So he invited me to tour the United States, partly as a fact-finding visit.”

lines.japanese:
「米国最高の高級住宅街でいろいろな邸宅を見て、
　自分の住む家のイメージを作ってくれて良いと」
lines.english: “He said I could look at different estates in America's most exclusive neighborhood and decide what sort of house I would like.”

lines.japanese:
「いざという時、避難できるとしたら大陸がベスト
　だからって」
lines.english: “He said the continent would be the best place to evacuate to if the worst happened.”

lines.japanese:
「もちろん、大統領自ら自宅にも招いてくれるとの
　ことです」
lines.english: “Naturally, the president himself would also host me at his home.”

lines.japanese:
再生に過ぎない。
　忍の耳を経由して、記憶領域に複写された微弱な
偏在信号。その音声出力。
lines.english: Only playback. The audio output of faint, localized signals copied into the memory region through Shinobu’s ears.

lines.japanese: 「僕は質問しました」
lines.english: “I asked him a question.”

lines.japanese: 「そこに、自分の居場所はあるだろうかって」
lines.english: “I asked whether there would be a place for me there.”

lines.japanese: 「彼は答えました。もちろんだ、って」
lines.english: “He answered: of course.”

lines.japanese:
「続けて、こうも訊きました。僕は向こうでは、許
　されるだろうかって」
lines.english: “Then I asked him this: Could I be forgiven over there?”

lines.japanese:
「……彼は答えました。誰もが僕を歓迎するだろう
　って」
lines.english: “...He answered that everyone would welcome me.”

lines.japanese:
「疲れているようですね。その話は結構ですから、
　今は―――」
lines.english: “You seem tired. We've heard enough of that. For now—”

lines.japanese:
そして忍は、声帯を激しく震わせながら、絞り出
すように、
lines.english: And then, his vocal cords trembling violently, Shinobu forced out—

lines.japanese: 怒声に変わる一歩手前の声で、
lines.english: in a voice one step short of a furious shout—

lines.japanese: 「誰が、僕を許せるんです？」
lines.english: “Who could ever forgive me?”

lines.japanese: 視線が、千鳥を貫いた。
lines.english: His gaze pierced Chidori.

lines.japanese:
あまりに強い眼光は、人を焼き殺す炯々たる熱量
を秘めて。
lines.english: His blazing gaze held heat fierce enough to burn a person alive.

lines.japanese:
「逆に、僕を罰することができる人間の数を数えて
　みたらいい。その多さに眩暈がするでしょうよ」
lines.english: “Try counting the people who could punish me instead. The number would make you dizzy.”

lines.japanese:
「人を外れたものを、人とは呼ばない。人ではない
　のなら、誰からも裁かれずまた許されない」
lines.english: “Something outside the bounds of humanity isn’t called human. And if it isn’t human, no one can judge it—or forgive it.”

lines.japanese:
「だけど……危機に立ち向かうには中途半端で……
　事を成せない」
lines.english: “But... I’m not enough to confront the crisis... I can’t get the job done.”

lines.japanese:
「……なら、僕が罪を犯す意義は、どこにあるんで
　すか？」
lines.english: “...Then what is the point of my committing a sin?”
“Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 静かに、しかし冷徹に、千鳥は命じた。
lines.english: Quietly, but with cold severity, Chidori gave an order.

lines.japanese: 「部屋に戻って、待機していなさい」
lines.english: “Return to your room and stand by.”

lines.japanese: 廊下に出ると、声をかけられた。
lines.english: Someone called to him when he stepped into the corridor.
“Hm?”

lines.japanese:
少年……相田とかいう名前。
　南の部下だ。
lines.english: The boy... Aida, if he remembered right. One of Minami's subordinates.

lines.japanese:
距離を置いて立っている。
　敵意はない。
lines.english: He stood some distance away. There was no hostility.

lines.japanese: 「怪我はしてないらしいな」
lines.english: “So you weren't hurt.”

lines.japanese: 「怪我？」
lines.english: “Hurt?”

lines.japanese:
昨日の屈辱について思い出す。
　少年の言葉は、たぶんに侮蔑的な意味合いを持っ
ていた。
lines.english: He remembered yesterday's humiliation. The boy's words carried a distinctly contemptuous edge.

lines.japanese: 忍はわずかながら、羞恥と反発を味わう。
lines.english: Shinobu tasted a little shame and defiance.

lines.japanese: 「……おかげさまで」
lines.english: “...Thanks to you.”

lines.japanese: 「皮肉くらいは言えるのか」
lines.english: “So you can manage sarcasm.”
“...What do you want?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえは南が連れてきた人間だ」
lines.english: “You're someone Minami brought here.”

lines.japanese:
直接的な回答はよこさずに、相田は自分のペース
で話し続ける。
lines.english: Aida gave him no direct answer, merely continuing at his own pace.

lines.japanese:
「南は秘密主義者だ。俺たちの多くが、おまえにつ
　いて知らない」
lines.english: “Minami keeps secrets. A lot of us don’t know anything about you.”

lines.japanese:
「けどな……南をはじめ、ここのお偉いさんがたは
　皆、おまえが新しいリーダーだと言う」
lines.english: “But... Minami and all the other brass here say you're the new leader.”

lines.japanese: 「理由の説明もなく、な」
lines.english: “Without explaining why.”

lines.japanese:
殺気にも似た敵意が、急激に生起させられる。
　場所を選ばず向けられた反感に、忍はただとまどう。
lines.english: Hostility bordering on bloodlust was suddenly roused. Shinobu was bewildered by resentment leveled at him with no regard for the setting.

lines.japanese: 「昨日、おまえは殺傷能力を使わなかった」
lines.english: “Yesterday, you didn't use your lethal ability.”

lines.japanese: 「あれは訓練で……」
lines.english: “That was only training...”

lines.japanese:
「誰もが、おまえの力を見たがっていたんだ。
　あれはそういう儀式だった」
lines.english: “Everyone wanted to see your power. That was the point of the ritual.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……」
「腕でも折ってやれば、使ったのか？」
lines.english: “Would you have used it if I'd broken your arm?”

lines.japanese:
敵意増大。
　忍は後ずさる。
lines.english: The hostility swelled. Shinobu stepped back.

lines.japanese: 「能力はなんだ。教えろ」
lines.english: “What's your ability? Tell me.”

lines.japanese: 「答えられない」
lines.english: “I can't answer that.”

lines.japanese: 「誰と面会をしていた？」
lines.english: “Who were you meeting with?”

lines.japanese: 「……答えられない」
lines.english: “...I can't answer that.”

lines.japanese:
逆撫でするとわかっていても、応じられない問い
もある。
lines.english: Even knowing it would provoke him, there were some questions Shinobu could not answer.

lines.japanese: 「そうか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
目を閉じて、開くと。
　すでに、始まっていた―――
lines.english: He closed his eyes, and when he opened them again—it had already begun.

lines.japanese: 「……異分子が」
lines.english: “...You don't belong here.”

lines.japanese:
排撃の意図が、渦流化した。
　相田の前面を覆う渦紋が、大盾を思わせる。
lines.english: The intent to drive him out became a vortex. The spiraling pattern covering Aida's front resembled a great shield.

lines.japanese: 「やめろ、相田」
lines.english: “Stop, Aida.”

lines.japanese:
盾が霧散する。
　二人の視線が、投げかけられた声の主を捜す。
　仄暗い闇の帳の向こうに、痩身の男が立っていた。
lines.english: The shield dispersed. They both looked for whoever had spoken. Beyond a dim curtain of darkness stood a slender man.

lines.japanese: 「立ち去れ」
lines.english: “Leave.”

lines.japanese:
かすかに表情を硬化させた。
　それが反発か恐怖かは、読み取れない。
lines.english: His expression hardened almost imperceptibly. Whether in defiance or fear, Shinobu could not tell.

lines.japanese:
背中を向けて、去っていった。
　忍の内心に、安堵が浮かぶ。
lines.english: Aida turned his back and walked away. Relief surfaced in Shinobu's mind.

lines.japanese: 「あの、どうも」
lines.english: “Um... thanks.”

lines.japanese:
男が歩いてくる。
　黒いスーツを着た、長身痩躯の人物。
lines.english: The man approached. A tall, lean figure in a black suit.
“You're...!”

lines.japanese: 知らない顔ではない。
lines.english: He knew that face.

lines.japanese: 灰野耕一郎―――
lines.english: Kouichirou Haino—

lines.japanese: 外見の印象通り、鋭利な男である。
lines.english: He was every bit as sharp as he looked.

lines.japanese:
「施設内での私闘は禁じられている。部屋に戻り、
　待機していろ」
lines.english: “Private fights are forbidden inside the facility. Return to your room and stand by.”

lines.japanese:
それだけ言うと、踵を返して去っていった。
　温情の欠片も、男の瞳には存在しない。
　機械知性に接したような気分。
lines.english: With that, he turned on his heel and left. There had not been a trace of compassion in his eyes. Shinobu felt as though he had encountered a machine intelligence.

lines.japanese:
組織の歯車を連想させる人物だった。
　効率しか考えない、力学の駆動体。
lines.english: The man brought to mind a cog in the organization. A mechanism driven by nothing but efficiency.

lines.japanese: 灰野を見送る忍もまた、冷たい目をしていた。
lines.english: Shinobu's eyes were equally cold as he watched Haino go.

lines.japanese:
自分は面白みのない、人形のような人間だと思っ
ていた。
lines.english: He had always thought himself a dull, doll-like person.

lines.japanese: なかなかどうして、わがままなんだと実感していた。
lines.english: Yet here he was, discovering just how selfish he could be.

lines.japanese: いや、この十年近くでわがままになったのか。
lines.english: Or had he grown selfish over almost a decade?

lines.japanese:
正常になったのか。
　今、去来するのは、のんびりとした時間への乾きだ。
lines.english: Or had he become normal? Now he felt a thirst for unhurried time.

lines.japanese: 家に帰りたい。
lines.english: He wanted to go home.

lines.japanese: 家に。
lines.english: Home.

lines.japanese: 戻りたい。
lines.english: He wanted to return.

lines.japanese:
ゆるやかな時の流れに。
　浸かりたい。
　仲間と呼べる者たちとの密な関係に。
lines.english: To the gentle flow of time. To immerse himself in it. To the intimate ties he shared with people he could call companions.

lines.japanese:
沈鬱な気分で、横たわる忍だった。
　本当に、この部屋では他にすることがない。
lines.english: Shinobu lay there, sunk in gloom. There truly was nothing else to do in this room.

lines.japanese: 「おいシノ、駄々ってんじゃねぇぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, Shino. Don’t throw a tantrum.”

lines.japanese:
もちろん、ここに章二はいない。
　幻想だ。
lines.english: Of course, Shouji was not here. It was a fantasy.

lines.japanese:
しかし幻聴ではない。
　だが、あまりにもリアルすぎた。
lines.english: It was no auditory hallucination. And yet it had been far too real.

lines.japanese: 「まいったな……」
lines.english: “This is bad...”

lines.japanese: たった二日で、かなり病んでいるようだ。
lines.english: Two days had apparently been enough to leave him in a pretty bad way.

lines.japanese: 電話が鳴った。
lines.english: The telephone rang.

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Hello.”

lines.japanese: 『私です』
lines.english: “It's me.”

lines.japanese:
『明日からは他のＵＳＥＲと一緒に、基礎訓練課程
　に参加してください。細かいことは、メールボッ
　クスにテキストとともに入れてあります』
lines.english: “Starting tomorrow, join the other USERs in the basic training course. The details have been placed in your mailbox with the relevant written materials.”

lines.japanese: 『朝五時起床です。備えて、今夜は早めに就寝を』
lines.english: “Wake-up is at five in the morning. Turn in early tonight so you’re ready.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
『足りないものがあった場合、内線の０３に連絡し
　て申告してください。たいがいのものは用意する
　ことができます』
lines.english: “If you lack anything, dial extension 03 and report it. We can provide most things.”

lines.japanese: 淡々と、千鳥。
lines.english: Chidori continued in the same matter-of-fact tone.

lines.japanese:
『午後は面会が入っています。担当者には話は通っ
　ていますから、昼食後は訓練には参加せず、自室
　で待機しているように』
lines.english: “You have a meeting scheduled in the afternoon. The person in charge has been informed, so after lunch, do not attend training. Remain in your room and stand by.”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 『何か質問は？』
lines.english: “Any questions?”

lines.japanese: 問いかけて、口ごもる。
lines.english: He began to ask, then faltered.

lines.japanese: 『なんですか？』
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese: 何を言う？
lines.english: What could he say?

lines.japanese: 「いえ。なんでもありません」
lines.english: “No. It's nothing.”

lines.japanese: 『そう……では、以上です』
lines.english: “I see... That will be all.”

lines.japanese:
電話が切れた。
　扉の内側にせり出したメールボックスには、確か
に封筒に詰められたテキスト類が入っていた。
lines.english: The call ended. The mailbox jutting from the inside of the door did indeed contain an envelope stuffed with written materials.

lines.japanese:
取り出して、中身をあらため、机に重ねて置いた。
　再び、寝台に横たわる。
lines.english: He took out the envelope, examined its contents, and stacked them on the desk. Then he lay on the bed once more.

lines.japanese:
明日からは、もっと忙しくなるのだろうか。
　だったら、可能な限り休むだけだ。
lines.english: Would he be busier starting tomorrow? If so, all he could do was rest as much as he could.

lines.japanese: 「……約束は守った……つもりなんだけどな」
lines.english: “...I thought I'd kept my promise...”

lines.japanese:
章二はどう思うだろう。
　仲間といえる者たち。
　ともにいた時間。場所。
lines.english: What would Shouji think? The people he could call companions. The time and place they had shared.

lines.japanese:
共有したもの―――
　たとえ、それが聖域の残骸だとしても。
　そのために殉じる自分でいようと、忍は思うのだ。
lines.english: What they shared—even if it was only the wreckage of a sanctuary. Shinobu meant to remain someone willing to die for it.

lines.japanese: 人類史最後の一ページが記されるまで。
lines.english: Until the final page of human history was written.

lines.japanese:
心の疲れがそうさせるのか、十分も経たずに、忍
は睡魔に突き落とされた。
lines.english: Perhaps his heart was simply exhausted; before even ten minutes had passed, sleep dragged Shinobu under.

lines.japanese:
翌朝、早朝五時。
　忍は訓練に参加した。
lines.english: Five o'clock the next morning. Shinobu took part in training.

lines.japanese:
それは七時まで続き、朝食の頃には半日も過ごし
たような気分だった。
lines.english: It continued until seven, and by breakfast he felt as though half the day had passed.
“Haaah...”

lines.japanese:
疲労困憊。
　幸い、食欲だけはある。
　大盛りカレーを、機械的に胃袋に詰める。
lines.english: Utterly exhausted. Fortunately, he still had an appetite. He mechanically shoveled down a large serving of curry.

lines.japanese:
朝に食すものでもないと思うが、致し方ない。
　このあとは、講義がある。
　優れた兵士には優れた教育。
lines.english: It was hardly breakfast fare, but there was no helping it. Lectures came next. A fine education for fine soldiers.

lines.japanese:
そんな方針。
　兵士―――
　そう、兵士なのだ。
lines.english: That was the policy. Soldiers—yes, soldiers.

lines.japanese:
教育ではなく訓練。
　そして武術、火器の取り扱い、ＵＳＥＲとしての
基礎知識。
lines.english: Not education, but training. And martial arts, the handling of firearms, and the basics of being a USER.

lines.japanese:
だが、どこか本格的ではない気がする。
　銃器の扱いなら、自衛隊の演習施設でも借りて、
実地でやらねば意味がない。
lines.english: Yet somehow it did not seem serious. If they were to learn firearms, there was no point unless they borrowed a Self-Defense Force training ground and practiced in the field.

lines.japanese:
今の訓練メニューからすると、本当に自衛のため
だけのものでしかない。
lines.english: Judging by the current curriculum, it was genuinely meant for nothing more than self-defense.

lines.japanese: 最低限の取り扱い。
lines.english: Just the basics of handling weapons.

lines.japanese:
自衛―――
　ＵＳＥＲが個々に自衛を必要とする局面。
lines.english: Self-defense—situations in which individual USERs would need to defend themselves.

lines.japanese:
少なくとも、組織だっての行動は想定されていな
いのだ。
lines.english: At the very least, no coordinated operations were anticipated.

lines.japanese: 「ま、いいか」
lines.english: “Well, whatever.”

lines.japanese: 忍にはどうでもいいことだ。
lines.english: None of it mattered to Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「おー、すげぇ食欲」
lines.english: “Whoa, what an appetite.”

lines.japanese: トレイを持ったジーンが来た。
lines.english: Gene approached with a tray.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう」
lines.english: “Morning.”

lines.japanese: 勝手に隣に座る。
lines.english: She sat beside him without asking.

lines.japanese: 「……おはよう」
lines.english: “...Morning.”

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Time to eat.”

lines.japanese: 「訓練、出てたね」
lines.english: “You were at training.”

lines.japanese: 「そう命じられたんだ」
lines.english: “I was ordered to attend.”

lines.japanese: 「どうだった、うちの教練？」
lines.english: “What did you think of our drills?”

lines.japanese: 「疲れた……」
lines.english: “I'm exhausted...”

lines.japanese: 「前時代的だからね」
lines.english: “They're pretty old-school.”

lines.japanese:
紅鮭を御飯の上に乗せて、豪快にカツカツとあお
るジーン。
lines.english: Gene piled the sockeye salmon onto her rice and shoveled it down with abandon.

lines.japanese: ……スプーンで。
lines.english: ...With a spoon.

lines.japanese: 「任務中は、体力作りしてなかったわけ？」
lines.english: “Didn't you keep in shape during your assignment?”

lines.japanese: 「多少はしてたけど」
lines.english: “A little.”

lines.japanese: 「ははあ、遊んでた？」
lines.english: “Aha. So you were off playing?”

lines.japanese: 否定はできない。
lines.english: He could not deny it.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、遊びますよな」
lines.english: “Well, of course you would.”

lines.japanese:
「そういえば……彼……相田？　姿が見えなかった
　みたいだけど……」
lines.english: “Come to think of it... he... Aida? I don't think I saw him at training...”

lines.japanese:
「仕事じゃないかな。ほら、ＯＢの灰野って人の助
　手によく駆り出されてるから」
lines.english: “Probably working. They often call him out to assist an alumnus named Haino.”

lines.japanese: 「……そう。なるほど」
lines.english: “...I see. That explains it.”

lines.japanese: 実戦経験があるということだ。
lines.english: So he had experience in actual combat.

lines.japanese: 「厄介だな……」
lines.english: “That could be trouble...”

lines.japanese:
なぜ厄介なのか。
　いつ厄介なのか。
lines.english: Why would it be trouble? When would it be trouble?

lines.japanese:
具体的な思考を伴わず、忍は曖昧な焦燥感をもて
あそぶ。
lines.english: Without any concrete thoughts to go with it, Shinobu toyed with a vague sense of agitation.

lines.japanese: ふと視線を感じて、横を見れば、
lines.english: He suddenly felt eyes on him and glanced to the side.

lines.japanese: ジーンの視線が、そこに置かれていた。
lines.english: Gene was staring at him.

lines.japanese: 「ニヤニヤ」
lines.english: “Grin, grin.”

lines.japanese: 「何を言ってるんだ」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「考えてる男の横顔ってわけだ」
lines.english: “The profile of a man lost in thought.”

lines.japanese: 「何を言ってるんだ」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「まいったなぁ」
lines.english: “Oh, dear.”

lines.japanese: 「よくわからないんだけど……」
lines.english: “I don't understand...”

lines.japanese: 「好感度が上がったよ」
lines.english: “My affection meter went up.”

lines.japanese:
びっ、と。
　指を立てて、ジーンは言う。
lines.english: With a flourish—Gene raised one finger as she spoke.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「ごはんつぶ、ついてる。唇に」
lines.english: “You've got a grain of rice on your lip.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 触れようとした手を、ジーンが掴んだ。
lines.english: Gene caught the hand he raised toward it.

lines.japanese: 「取ってあげるよ」
lines.english: “I'll get it for you.”

lines.japanese: 顔が接近してきた。
lines.english: Her face came closer.
“...What?”
“Mm.”

lines.japanese: 零距離になった。
lines.english: The distance fell to zero.

lines.japanese: また離れた。
lines.english: Then she moved away again.

lines.japanese: 「講義はめんどいよねー。じゃ！」
lines.english: “Lectures are such a pain. Later!”

lines.japanese: 風のように去りぬ。
lines.english: Gone like the wind.

lines.japanese: 忍は取り残された。
lines.english: Shinobu was left behind.

lines.japanese: 「隙があるから、そうなる」
lines.english: “That's what happens when you leave yourself open.”
“Minami...”

lines.japanese: 「キス魔なんだ。何人もやられてる」
lines.english: “She's a compulsive kisser. Plenty of people have fallen victim.”

lines.japanese: 「おかしいと思うんだけど……」
lines.english: “That isn't normal...”

lines.japanese: 「正気なやつなんていない」
lines.english: “No one here is sane.”

lines.japanese:
トレイを片手に、南は背を向けた。自分の食事は
終わっていたらしい。
lines.english: Tray in one hand, Minami turned his back. Apparently he had finished his meal.

lines.japanese: 「いちいち相手にしても仕方がない」
lines.english: “There's no point reacting every single time.”

lines.japanese: 「と言っても……」
lines.english: “Even so...”

lines.japanese: 唇を押さえる。
lines.english: He covered his lips.

lines.japanese:
一種の親愛の行為なのだろうか。本当にそうだろ
うか？

贈与物が禁止されているためか、彼らは一様に忍

発する大人も、受ける自分も……溶けて空洞化し

薄皮に包まれた蛆の群れを見るように、不快なだ

微睡みから呼び覚まされ、研究室に連れて行かれ、

元々“聖域”ではない彼女に対し、落胆するため

lines.english: “Nothing in particular. Except...”

lines.english: “Except?”

lines.english: “Just a little headache.”

lines.japanese: 「……鎮痛剤は必要だと思いますか？」
lines.english: “...Do you think you need painkillers?”

lines.japanese: 「なるべくなら、使いたくないんですが」
lines.english: “I'd rather avoid them, if possible.”

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 「お願いします」

lines.japanese:
「まともな仕事ができる程度には、揃っているみた
　いだな」
lines.english: “It looks as though you have enough equipment here to do a proper job.”

lines.japanese:
第一声が、それだった。
　忍に目をとめ、
lines.english: That was his opening remark. Then his eyes settled on Shinobu—

lines.japanese: 「で、きみが貴宮忍か？」
lines.english: “And you're Shinobu Atemiya?”

lines.japanese: 「はい……ええと？」
lines.english: “Yes... Um, you are?”

lines.japanese: 「邑西だ」
lines.english: “Yuuzai.”

lines.japanese: 「邑西さん……？」
lines.english: “Mr. Yuuzai...?”

lines.japanese:
「知伝子学のオーソリティー、邑西先生。あなたの
　メンテナンスも担当していただくことになってい
　ます」
lines.english: “Dr. Yuuzai is an authority on informational genetics. He will also be responsible for your maintenance.”

lines.japanese: 「知伝子学、ですか？」
lines.english: “Informational genetics?”

lines.japanese: 「環境組織化の形成促進のための基礎技術です」
lines.english: “The foundational technology used to accelerate environmental organization.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、つまり―――」
lines.english: “Oh, so—”

lines.japanese: 忍の言葉を遮り、男は口を開いた。
lines.english: Before Shinobu could finish, the man cut him off.

lines.japanese:
「カルテを見せてくれ。持ち出し厳禁ということ
　で、事前に基礎的なデータさえもらっていない。
　早急に検証せねば、次の手順にも入れない」
lines.english: “Let me see the chart. Since it cannot be taken off the premises, I haven’t received even the basic data in advance. I need to verify it promptly before I can proceed to the next step.”

lines.japanese:
本題から入るタイプの人間らしい。
　合理化された学識者は、人間関係においても無駄
を省きたがる。
lines.english: Apparently he liked to get straight to the point. The streamlined scholar wanted to eliminate waste even from human relationships.

lines.japanese: 「こちらです」
lines.english: “Here it is.”

lines.japanese:
動じることなく、千鳥は書類を渡す。
　書類が鍵付きのケースから取り出されたのを見て、
lines.english: Unperturbed, Chidori handed over the documents. Seeing her take them from a locked case—

lines.japanese: 「……厳重だな」
lines.english: “...Heavy security.”

lines.japanese: 「機密となっておりますので」
lines.english: “The file is classified.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ。室外への持ち出しも駄目か」
lines.english: “Hm. Can't take it out of the room, either?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。くれぐれも」
lines.english: “Correct. Under no circumstances.”

lines.japanese: 「わかっている」
lines.english: “I know.”

lines.japanese: 短く応じると、椅子に座って書類を読み始めた。
lines.english: With that curt response, he sat down and began reading the file.

lines.japanese: 忍は何をしていいか、わからない。
lines.english: Shinobu did not know what he was supposed to do.

lines.japanese:
学者の片眉が歪む。
　最小限の動きは、驚愕の表情である。
　書類上を走る、視線の速度が増す。
lines.english: One of the scholar's eyebrows drew tight. On him, that tiny motion amounted to astonishment. His gaze raced faster across the pages.

lines.japanese:
走査装置を思わせる瞳の動き。
　忍はその様子から、目を背けることができなくな
った。
lines.english: His eyes tracked the pages like a scanner. Shinobu found himself unable to look away from the sight.

lines.japanese:
学者が知性の果てに掴んだ能力は、常人に真似で
きない速度と理解力で、書類を次々に情報化してい
った。
lines.english: The ability the scholar had acquired at the limits of intellect converted one document after another into information, with speed and comprehension no ordinary person could match.

lines.japanese:
目には見えない知性のうねりが、忍には確かに感
じられた。
lines.english: Shinobu could unmistakably feel the invisible surge of intellect.

lines.japanese:
知性とは、不思議な現象である。
　文字と数式を印刷した紙切れが、ただ視野に入る
だけで、人は脳機能を増強できる。
lines.english: Intelligence was a strange phenomenon. A person could augment the workings of their own brain merely by bringing scraps of paper printed with words and equations into view.

lines.japanese:
その果てにあるものに、忍は興味がある。推論し
ている。
lines.english: Shinobu was fascinated by what lay at its furthest limit. He was trying to deduce—

lines.japanese: 知性の結末というものに。
lines.english: the final destination of intelligence.

lines.japanese: 「忍、検査をするから、隣に」
lines.english: “Shinobu, it's time for your examination. Next room.”

lines.japanese: 「待ってくれ」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese:
応じかけた忍を、学者が制した。
　忍を見る。
　黒檀のような瞳孔に、忍は調査される。
lines.english: The scholar stopped Shinobu as he was about to comply. He looked at Shinobu. Pupils like ebony examined him.

lines.japanese:
書類を封筒に戻し、立ち上がる。
隣の装置類を顎で示し、
lines.english: He slid the documents back into the envelope and stood. With a jerk of his chin toward the equipment next door—

lines.japanese:
「……その機種ははじめてだ。
　立ち上げ手順を教えてくれ。一度で憶える」
lines.english: “...That model is new to me. Show me how to start it up. Once will be enough.”

lines.japanese: 「以降、私の仕事だろうからな」
lines.english: “It will presumably be my job from now on.”

lines.japanese: それからの日々に、変化があったわけではない。
lines.english: The days that followed brought no change.

lines.japanese:
訓練。
　検査。
lines.english: Training. Examinations.

lines.japanese:
食事。
　睡眠。
lines.english: Meals. Sleep.

lines.japanese: 灰色のサイクルに、彩りはない。
lines.english: The gray cycle held no color.

lines.japanese: 「遊びに来た」
lines.english: “I came to hang out.”

lines.japanese: 彩りと思えるものはあったのかも知れない。
lines.english: Perhaps there had been something he could call color.

lines.japanese: 「ヘイ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.english: He rolled over, turning his back to her.

lines.japanese: 「なんだなんだ、寝るのか」
lines.english: “What, you're going to sleep?”

lines.japanese:
明るい少女だ。
　だが依存はできない。
　彼女を選んではならない。
lines.english: A cheerful girl. But he couldn't depend on her. He mustn't choose her.

lines.japanese:
忍の本音は、そう告げていた。
　生涯の仲間は六人だけだったのだ。
　もう増えたりはしない。
lines.english: His true feelings told him so. He had only six lifelong companions. There would be no more.

lines.japanese:
増やすつもりはない。
　ましてやＵＳＥＲなるものを存在させる元凶とな
った施設。
lines.english: He had no intention of adding any. Least of all here, at the facility responsible for bringing those things called USERs into existence.

lines.japanese:
ここには冷たさしかない。
　信じれば、裏切られることが確定的な空間だ。
lines.english: There was nothing but coldness here. To trust here was to ensure betrayal.

lines.japanese: 「……ちぇー、帰るよー、帰っちゃうよー」
lines.english: “...Aw, fine. I'm going, okay? I'm really leaving.”

lines.japanese: 「……なんだよ」
lines.english: “...What gives?”

lines.japanese: しばらくして、扉が閉じられる音。
lines.english: After a while came the sound of the door closing.

lines.japanese: 吐息―――
lines.english: A sigh—

lines.japanese:
相田という少年は、あれから接触してくることは
なかった。

lines.japanese: 時折、見られている感覚だけはあった。
lines.english: From time to time, Shinobu merely sensed eyes on him.

灰野の釘がまだ刺さったままなのか、どうか。

lines.english: Was Haino’s warning still lodged in him? Everyone but Minami still looked at Shinobu with glittering hostility.

運動にかこつけた強めの接触など、意にも介さな
い忍は……彼らにとってどう映っただろう。
lines.english: How must Shinobu have looked to them, unfazed by their rough collisions disguised as exercise?

lines.english: Surely they didn't imagine they could overwhelm him by force of numbers.

だが忍の未知な部分は、彼らにとって恐怖の対象

lines.japanese: 「おまえはどちらにつく」
lines.english: “Which side are you on?”

lines.english: The process, the reasons—none of that mattered. Every meeting had one thing in common: only the end result had any value.

前置きを掘り出して、やっと出てくるシンプルな

lines.english: The simple demand that emerged only after he dug through all the preamble.

日本政府か、米国政府か。

lines.english: The Japanese government, or the American. Neither offered “stay here at the facility” as an option.

群像委員会は現在、事実上、貴宮千鳥を中心にし
て回っている組織だ。
lines.english: At present, the Ensemble Committee effectively revolved around Chidori Atemiya.

もちろん彼女は優秀な人材だが、組織を取り回す

lines.english: She was unquestionably talented, but in running an organization her youth could only hinder her.

lines.japanese: 能力の問題ではない。

千鳥がいかに優秀であっても、国家レベルのやり
とりにおいては御輿にしか成り得ない。
lines.english: However capable Chidori might be, in dealings at the national level she could serve only as a figurehead.

lines.english: And probably not just money. They must have been granted benefits beyond compare. But those were no more than bait.

多少の地位を有していたとして、所詮は学者集団

lines.english: Whatever status it possessed, the Ensemble Committee was ultimately no more than a group of scholars. It could not hold its own against politicians.

恭順の意を示しているはずだ。

lines.english: It must have signaled its submission. That made Shinobu's position a delicate one. Shinobu: the irreplaceable component.

lines.japanese:
千鳥の弟であり、施設の一員であり、彼らには決

lines.english: Chidori's brother, a member of the facility, and an advanced unit they could never handle.

lines.japanese:
忍の意志を味方につけるということが、いかに重

lines.english: It hardly needed saying how important it was to secure Shinobu's willing support.

lines.english: “...Absurd.”

そして現況下で、これほど馬鹿げた時間の浪費も
ない。
lines.english: And under the present circumstances, there could be no more absurd waste of time.

lines.english: “Our antagonisms and balance of power with Europe and Asia will be overturned, and every current will shift. This is the turning point.”

lines.japanese: 「そのことを誰もが意識している」
lines.english: “Everyone is aware of that.”

lines.japanese:
「このことが終わったあとの事は、考えられない
　か？」
lines.english: “Can't you think about what comes after this is over?”

lines.japanese: 「……終わったあとだって？」
lines.english: “...After it's over?”

lines.japanese:
声が弾む。
　喜びではなく、蔑みによって。
lines.english: His voice lifted. Not with joy, but with contempt.

lines.japanese: 「終わったらだろう、それは！」
lines.english: “You mean if it ends at all!”
“What?”

lines.japanese:
「無事に終わるならそれでいいさ。政治でも何でも
　やるといい」
lines.english: “If it ends safely, that's enough. Then you can play politics or do whatever else you like.”

lines.japanese:
「……終わらない可能性だってある。どうしてそれ

lines.english: “...It may never end. Why don't you consider that?”

lines.japanese: 「終わらない、だと？」
lines.english: “You mean it might not end?”

　完全な終わりだろうからね、それは」
lines.english: “That's right. Or perhaps, in one sense, it will. It would be an absolute end.”

lines.english: “...Ridiculous. What kind of war leaves no one alive?”

lines.japanese: 「あるかも知れない」
lines.english: “There might be one.”

lines.japanese: 「侵略によって、か？」
lines.english: “An invasion?”

lines.japanese: 「さあね」
lines.english: “Who knows?”

lines.japanese:
「俺たちの力をおまえが指揮する……そして敵を撃
　退し、支配する」
lines.english: “You command our power... repel the enemy, and take control.”

lines.japanese:
「静的侵略というやつだ。確かにこの力をうまく使
　えば、そういったこともできるだろうぜ」
lines.english: “They call it a static invasion. Use this power well, and we could certainly manage something like that.”

lines.japanese:
「なら訊くけど……
　当然、戦争するなら敵がいるよね」
lines.english: “Then let me ask you something... A war means an enemy, naturally.”

lines.japanese: 「当然だ」
lines.english: “Naturally.”

lines.japanese: 「それ、誰？」
lines.english: “Who?”

lines.japanese: 時間が止まる。
lines.english: Time stopped.
“...The enemy is... the enemy... isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 戸惑う相田を、忍は冷淡な眼差しで見つめた。
lines.english: Shinobu regarded the bewildered Aida with a cold stare.
“The enemy is...”

lines.japanese: 「敵は？」
lines.english: “Who is the enemy?”

lines.japanese: 長身痩躯がよろめく。
lines.english: His tall, lean frame staggered.

lines.japanese: 壁に当たる。
lines.english: He struck the wall.

lines.japanese: 「だって……おまえ……」
lines.english: “But... you...”

lines.japanese:
「自分のものと思えた思考が、実は誰かによってコ
　ントロールされたものだって可能性がある。
　僕らには当たり前のようにある」
lines.english: “Thoughts you believed were your own may actually have been controlled by someone else. For people like us, that possibility is perfectly ordinary.”

lines.japanese:
「どこからが自然で、どこからが人為か、主観は区
　別することができないんだ」
lines.english: “From the inside, we can't tell where nature ends and artifice begins.”

lines.japanese:
「君の個性は何のためにあるんだろう。理由なんて
　ありゃしないのさ。人間としてのノイズこそが、
　君だ」
lines.english: “What is your individuality for? There isn’t any reason for it. The noise of being human—that’s you.”

lines.japanese:
「だけどその知識だけは別だ……幾重にもプロテクト
　がかけられている」
lines.english: “But that one piece of knowledge is different... It is protected by layer after layer.”

lines.japanese:
「本当の意味で、枷のない思考を許されているのは
　ごく一部だけなんだ」
lines.english: “Only a tiny handful are permitted truly unfettered thought.”

lines.japanese:
「そして誰が味方かなんてもう決まってる。君たち
　は決して逆らえない。本来とは異なった主に膝を
　つくことはできない」
lines.english: “And your allies were decided long ago. You can never resist. You cannot kneel to a master other than the one you were meant to serve.”

lines.japanese:
「君はＡ級ＵＳＥＲだろ。なら、決して知ることの
　できない情報がある。視覚とかじゃない」
lines.english: “You're a Class A USER, aren't you? Then there is information you can never know. It isn't a matter of sight.”

lines.japanese:
「ハードウェアの問題として、君の脳はこの情報を
　咀嚼できないんだ」
lines.english: “At the hardware level, your brain cannot digest this information.”

lines.japanese:
「気分が悪いだろう？　その不調は阻害因子が分泌
　されているからだ。どんな高い処理能力を持った
　ＵＳＥＲでも、他人の意識を操ることは難しい」
lines.english: “You feel sick, don't you? That's because inhibitory factors are being secreted. However much processing power a USER possesses, controlling another person's consciousness is difficult.”

lines.japanese:
「自我っていうのはそれだけで強烈なファイヤー
　ウォールだからね」
lines.english: “The ego itself is an extremely powerful firewall.”

lines.japanese:
「だけどそれが根本的なものである場合、さすがに
　空白のままというわけにはいかない。だから漠然
　とした流れをつけてコントロールされる」
lines.english: “But when the information is fundamental, it obviously can't be left blank. So you are given a vague direction and controlled through that.”

lines.japanese:
「概念を読解というのはこういうことができるのさ。
　本人の主観側に手を加えることで、エンコード自体
　を阻害することができる」
lines.english: “This is what concept-reading can do. By altering the subject's own perspective, you can interfere with the encoding itself.”

lines.japanese:
「たとえば君が何らかの掲示板を見て、その情報に
　触れたとしても……適切に理解することはできな
　い」
lines.english: “For instance, even if you saw a message board and encountered that information... you would be unable to understand it correctly.”

lines.japanese:
「あらかじめつけられた流れにそって誤解してしま
　うのさ」
lines.english: “You would misread it according to the flow laid down in advance.”

lines.japanese: 「……誰が……こんなことを……？」
lines.english: “...Who... did this...?”

lines.japanese: 「……さあね。少なくとも僕じゃないよ」
lines.english: “...Who knows? It wasn't me, at least.”

lines.japanese:
「矛盾を突けば綻ぶほど、その情報については強烈
　な方向付けをされているわけだよ」
lines.english: “Your thinking on that information has been so forcefully directed that probing a contradiction makes it come apart.”

lines.japanese: 「……意識をそらすといい。じきに楽になる」
lines.english: “...Turn your mind away from it. You'll feel better soon.”

lines.japanese:
「僕らは、君が思っているほどスタンドアローンじゃ
　ない」
lines.english: “We aren't nearly as stand-alone as you think.”

lines.japanese:
「あまり過信しないことだよ。自分も、他人も。
　じゃあね」
lines.english: “Don't put too much faith in yourself—or in anyone else. Later.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、待て……なぜそんな……待て……ッ！」
lines.english: “W-wait... Why do you... Wait...!”

lines.japanese: 「あまり考えすぎると、頭痛癖がつくよ」
lines.english: “Think too much and you'll develop chronic headaches.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえは！　おまえは全てを知っているのか！？」
lines.english: “You—you know everything!?”

lines.japanese:
「……さあ。まあ一応はそうなってるけど……覚醒
　状態に従って段階的にしかわからないようになっ
　ててね」
lines.english: “...Who knows? That’s technically how it’s set up... but I can only understand it in stages, depending on my state of awakening.”

lines.japanese: 「今の状態じゃ、アクセスも不自由なくらいさ」
lines.english: “At my current stage, even my access is limited.”

lines.japanese:
「ただ一応、全てを知る人間の一人ではあるはずだ
　よ」
lines.english: “Still, I should technically be one of the people who knows everything.”

lines.japanese:
瞳はしばし忍のいるあたりをふらつき、床に落ち
て、壁によじ登った。
lines.english: For a time, his gaze drifted around Shinobu, fell to the floor, then crawled up the wall.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ……」
lines.english: “Hahaha...”

lines.japanese: 背を向けて、歩み去った。
lines.english: Shinobu turned his back and walked away.
“Hm?”

lines.japanese:
廊下に銀色に光るものが落ちていた。
　拾い上げる。
　ロケットだ。
lines.english: Something silver and gleaming lay in the corridor. He picked it up. A locket.

lines.japanese:
軽い気持ちで開く。
　幼い少年の写真が映っている。
　５歳くらいだろうか。もっと下だろうか。
lines.english: He opened it casually. Inside was a photograph of a young boy. Around five, perhaps. Or younger.

lines.japanese: 「貴宮忍か……写真なんて残ってたんだ」
lines.english: “Shinobu Atemiya... So a photograph survived.”

lines.japanese:
急激に興味を失う。
　忍はそれを捨てようか着服しようか迷って、結局
ポケットに入れた。
lines.english: He abruptly lost interest. Shinobu wavered between throwing it away and keeping it for himself; in the end, he slipped it into his pocket.

lines.japanese: そして―――
lines.english: And then—

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間、倒れた。
lines.english: In the next instant, he collapsed.

lines.japanese:
ベッドに乗せられていた。
　いつ帰ってきたのだろう、記憶がない。
　眠気はなかった。
lines.english: He had been laid on a bed. When had he come back? He could not remember. He was not sleepy.

lines.japanese:
それよりも喉が渇いていた。
　水を、水を、水を、飲んだ。
　三杯飲んでまだ乾いた。
lines.english: More than anything, he was thirsty. He drank water, water, water. Three glasses, and he was still parched.

lines.japanese: 四杯目を干して、ようやく一息ついた。
lines.english: He drained a fourth glass and finally caught his breath.

lines.japanese:
落ち着くと、部屋の白さが急激に不快に思われ、
外に行きたくなった。
lines.english: As he calmed down, the room’s whiteness suddenly became unpleasant, and he wanted to go outside.

lines.japanese: 実行した。
lines.english: So he did.

lines.japanese:
午後の草原は無風だった。
　風一つなく、快晴の空。
　忍は瞑想するように、そこに座っていた。
lines.english: The field lay windless in the afternoon. Not a breath of air beneath a clear sky. Shinobu sat there as though meditating.

lines.japanese:
ポケットから、何かを取り出す。
　例のロケットだ。
　開けば、少年の写真。
lines.english: He drew something from his pocket. The locket from before. He opened it to find the boy's photograph.

lines.japanese:
その顔立ちがどことなく忍と似ているのは、単な
る偶然だろう。
lines.english: That the face bore a faint resemblance to Shinobu's must have been mere coincidence.

lines.japanese: ただ雰囲気が、同じなのだ。
lines.english: Yet they had the same air.

lines.japanese: 「貴宮くーん」
lines.english: “Atemiyaaa!”

lines.japanese: 少女がとたとたと駆け寄ってきた。
lines.english: The girl came trotting over.

lines.japanese: 無邪気なものだ。
lines.english: Innocent as could be.

lines.japanese: 「ずさー！」
lines.english: “Sliiide!”

lines.japanese: スライディングしてきた。
lines.english: She slid straight toward him.

lines.japanese: 「うわっ！」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: 腰に頭突きをくらう。
lines.english: She headbutted him in the hip.

lines.japanese: 「そういうのやめなよ！」
lines.english: “Cut that out!”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ。えはは」
lines.english: “Hee hee. Eheh heh.”

lines.japanese: 非常に楽しそうだった。
lines.english: She was having a wonderful time.

lines.japanese: （下手に怒っても喜ばせるだけだ……）
lines.english: (Getting angry would only make her happier...)

lines.japanese: 「何してたんですか？」
lines.english: “What were you doing?”

lines.japanese: 「何もしていなかったんだ」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「哲学みたい」
lines.english: “How philosophical.”

lines.japanese: 少女は感心した。
lines.english: The girl was impressed.

lines.japanese: 切り返された気分。
lines.english: He felt as though she'd turned that one back on him.

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ。友達のよしみで許してくださいよ」
lines.english: “Come, come. Forgive me for friendship's sake.”

lines.japanese: 「友達って、君……」
lines.english: “Friends? You and I...”

lines.japanese: 「友達じゃないですか、オス」
lines.english: “We're friends, aren't we? Yo!”

lines.japanese: 「うーん」
lines.english: “Hmmm.”

lines.japanese: 困ってしまう。
lines.english: Now he was at a loss.

lines.japanese: 友達。
lines.english: Friends.

lines.japanese:
シャーリー以外からそう言われたら、即座に否定
したのは間違いない。
lines.english: Had anyone but Shirley said it, he would unquestionably have denied it at once.

lines.japanese:
彼女はあまりにも打算がない。
　突っぱねるタイミングは難しい。
lines.english: She had no ulterior motive whatsoever. It was difficult to find the right moment to rebuff her.
“Which means—”

lines.japanese: 「はいはい？」
lines.english: “Yes, yes?”

lines.japanese:
悪い子ではない。
　歯車さえ合えば、友達にだってなれただろう。
lines.english: She was not a bad girl. If their gears had meshed, they could have been friends.

lines.japanese:
だけど忍の心には、すでに印刷されてしまった聖域
がある。
lines.english: But a sanctuary had already been printed into Shinobu's heart.

lines.japanese: それ以外の相手は、二の次になってしまうのだ。
lines.english: Everyone else could only come second.

lines.japanese: 「おまえは友達だけど一番大切じゃない」
lines.english: “You're my friend, but you're not the most important.”

lines.japanese: などと言われて、嬉しい者はいない。
lines.english: No one would be glad to hear that.

lines.japanese:
だから一番があるのなら、意図的に友人を得よう
とするべきではない。
lines.english: So if someone already came first, he ought not deliberately seek out more friends.

lines.japanese:
ということを、忍は苦心して説明した。
　それに。
lines.english: Shinobu went to great pains to explain all this. And besides—

lines.japanese: （エゴに取り込む対象は、少ない方がいい）
lines.english: (The fewer people I draw into my ego, the better.)

lines.japanese: いつも忍は考えている。
lines.english: It was something Shinobu always thought about.

lines.japanese:
友達だから。
　何よりも大切だから。
lines.english: Because they were friends. Because they mattered more than anything.

lines.japanese:
……それは、『優先』されるべきであると。
　罪深いのは、忍が王であること。
　王は平等でなければならない。
lines.english: ...They must be given “priority.” Shinobu's sin was that he was king. A king must treat everyone equally.

lines.japanese: 忍は王の義務を、最初から放棄しているのだ。
lines.english: Shinobu had forsaken the duties of a king from the very beginning.

lines.japanese: 「……そんなわけで、友達はもう間に合ってるんだ」
lines.english: “...So that's why I already have enough friends.”

lines.japanese: 正直に告げる忍も忍である。
lines.english: And it was just like Shinobu to tell her so honestly.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅん」
lines.english: “Hmmm.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、わたしは一番でなくてもいいですよ」
lines.english: “But I don't mind if I'm not first.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「頭壊れているんで、気にならないです。はい」
lines.english: “My head is broken, so it doesn't bother me. Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは……だから」
lines.english: “No, that's... The point is...”

lines.japanese:
「貴宮くんは、友達以外とは口きかないって決めて
　いるんですか？」
lines.english: “Atemiya, have you decided never to speak to anyone but your friends?”

lines.japanese: 「そうじゃないよ。ただ気持ちの問題として」
lines.english: “It's not that. I only meant how I feel.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、わたしが一方的に友達に思うってことで」
lines.english: “Then I shall consider you my friend unilaterally.”

lines.japanese: 満面の笑み。
lines.english: She beamed.

lines.japanese:
「と言いますか、いつもそうだった気がしますな……
　うむむ」
lines.english: “Or rather, I feel as though that has always been the case... Hrmm.”

lines.japanese: 考え込む。
lines.english: She sank into thought.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、いいか」
lines.english: “Oh well.”

lines.japanese: 「とにかく、ノー問題ってことで」
lines.english: “Anyway, no problemo.”

lines.japanese: 言葉を失う。
lines.english: He was lost for words.

lines.japanese: （どうして……今になって、こんな子が）
lines.english: (Why... now of all times, a girl like this?)

lines.japanese:
かつて。
　誰もいなかった施設。
　大人たちだけの場所。
lines.english: Long ago. A facility with no one in it. A place for adults alone.

lines.japanese:
久しぶりに帰還してみれば、同世代の人間は増え
ていて。
lines.english: When he returned after so long, he found more people his own age.

lines.japanese: だけど……親しみはなくて。
lines.english: But... none of them felt close.

lines.japanese:
敵意・憎悪・そねみ。
　嫉妬・不和・反感。
lines.english: Hostility. Hatred. Resentment. Jealousy. Discord. Antipathy.

lines.japanese:
結局、忍がその人生で得ることができた友情の機
会は、数えるほどしかない。
lines.english: In the end, Shinobu had found only a handful of chances at friendship in his whole life.

lines.japanese: 沙也加たちとの出会いは、任務上の必然だったが。
lines.english: Meeting Sayaka and the others had been an inevitable part of his assignment.

lines.japanese:
触れあい、気持ちをわけあったのは……幸運と言
えた。
lines.english: But that they had connected and shared their feelings... that was sheer good fortune.

lines.japanese: もし、そこで忍がなお任務を優先していたら―――
lines.english: If Shinobu had continued to put the assignment first—

lines.japanese:
……恐ろしくて、身が竦む。
　寒く広い世界に、忍は守る価値を見いだすことは
できなかった。
lines.english: ...The thought terrified him into stillness. In the cold, vast world, Shinobu had been unable to find anything worth protecting.

lines.japanese:
矛盾。
　誰かを愛せなければ、守らない。
　誰かを愛すれば、王としての立場を問われる。
lines.english: A contradiction. If he could not love someone, he would protect nothing. If he loved someone, his position as king would be called into question.

lines.japanese:
そして施設で出会った、少女のあたたかさに、忍
は戸惑う。
lines.english: And Shinobu was bewildered by the warmth of the girl he had met at the facility.

lines.japanese: 「……もしもーし？」
lines.english: “...Hellooo?”
“Mm.”

lines.japanese: 不意に、頭痛がした。
lines.english: A headache struck without warning.

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫？」
lines.english: “Are you all right?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、気にしないでいい……」
lines.english: “I'm fine. Don't worry about it...”

lines.japanese: 優しい声さえ、今は鬱陶しい。
lines.english: Even her gentle voice grated on him now.

lines.japanese: 「一人に、してくれないか」
lines.english: “Could you leave me alone?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなわけにいきませんよ！」
lines.english: “I can't do that!”

lines.japanese: 「大声は……やめて」
lines.english: “Don't... shout.”

lines.japanese: 頭に響く。
lines.english: It rang through his skull.
“Oh, sorr—”

lines.japanese: 「隊長……じゃあ、どうしたら？」
lines.english: “Captain... Then what should I do?”

lines.japanese: 「隊長ってなに」
lines.english: “What do you mean by ‘Captain’?”

lines.japanese: 「貴宮君は、わたしたちの隊長だって聞いたから」
lines.english: “Atemiya, I heard you were our captain.”

lines.japanese:
「……う、そんなんじゃ……あるけど……
　実質の指揮権があるわけじゃない」
lines.english: “...Uh, I’m not... well, I am... but I don’t actually have command authority.”

lines.japanese: 「でもでも、わたしは隊長に従いますよ？」
lines.english: “But, but I intend to obey you, Captain.”

lines.japanese: 「…………まいったな」
今さら、友達など。
lines.english: Friends, now of all times.

lines.japanese:
「いつものことなんだよ。
　君だって頭痛くらいあったろ？」
lines.english: “This happens all the time. You've had headaches too, haven't you?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、あった」
lines.english: “Mmm. I have.”

lines.japanese: 「僕たちは、みんなこれを抱えて生きていくんだよ」
lines.english: “All of us have to live with this.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ阿片チンキどうぞ」
lines.english: “Then have some laudanum.”

lines.japanese: ポシェットをまさぐる。
lines.english: She rummaged through her pouch.

lines.japanese: 「何言ってるんだよっ」
lines.english: “What are you talking about!?”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Here you go.”

lines.japanese: それを取り出す。
lines.english: She took it out.

lines.japanese: 「……金平糖に見えるんだけど」
lines.english: “...That looks like rock candy.”

lines.japanese:
「阿片チンキなんだそうですよ。実際、なめると
　頭痛が消えるのです」
lines.english: “They say it’s laudanum. Licking it really does make the headache go away.”

lines.japanese:
「……いや、だったらなおさらまずい。
　だいたい今時そんなものが……」
lines.english: “...No, that only makes it worse. And who even has stuff like that nowadays...?”

lines.japanese:
無理矢理、渡された。
　あるはずない。
　そう、あるはずはないのだ。
lines.english: She forced it into his hand. It couldn’t be. No. There was no way it could.

lines.japanese: 「というか、間違いなく金平糖じゃないか」
lines.english: “I mean, that's obviously just rock candy.”

lines.japanese: 「わたしもそう思います」
lines.english: “I think so too.”

lines.japanese: と、一つを口に放り込む。
lines.english: And she popped one into her mouth.

lines.japanese: 「ほら、すぐ痛みが消えて……」
lines.english: “See? The pain goes away right away...”

lines.japanese:
「それは、血糖値に関係した頭痛なんじゃないのか
　な」
lines.english: “Doesn't that mean the headache has something to do with your blood sugar?”

lines.japanese: 「だと思います」
lines.english: “I think so.”

lines.japanese:
なんだ、ともらった金平糖を口に放り込む。
　本当にそれは、ただの砂糖菓子だった。
lines.english: Oh, that was all. He popped the candy she had given him into his mouth. It really was just sugar candy.

lines.japanese: 「糖分を摂取すると、能力があがります」
lines.english: “Sugar boosts my abilities.”
